+import TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.IdentityBased.BonehBoyenMachine.Reduction
+
+set_option maxHeartbeats 0
+set_option relaxedAutoImplicit false
+set_option autoImplicit false
+
+/-!
+# The simulator's oracles with fresh exponents, and the simulation against the machine
+
+Helper module of `AdvancedEncryption/IdentityBased/BonehBoyenMachine.lean` (step 3 of
+[BB04, proof of Theorem 4.1] at depth `ℓ = 1`). Fix the group described by `d = desc(κ, r)` and
+the Decision BDH tuple `(g, X, Y, Z, T)`.
+* Call by call, the simulator's oracles `bb1SimImpl` (ideal uniform exponents, on the game's query
+  and answer types) have the law of `drawStep` with a fresh uniform exponent per query, read on
+  the game's lengths (`castImpl` of `ETTGame.freshImpl`). This step reads the game's oracles and
+  the scheme's encodings through the readers `IBEScheme.oracleImpl_zero_onSpec`, `_one_onSpec`,
+  `_two_onSpec`, `ofFn_bb1Scheme_encPP`, `ofFn_bb1Scheme_encSK`, `bb1Scheme_msgSpace_iff` and
+  `ofFn_bb1SimCt`.
+* Hence, on one tuple, the probability that `A` outputs `1` against the simulator and the
+  probability that the machine of the handler theorem T1 accepts the tuple's string differ by at
+  most `q(κ) · (1/2)^n` (`abs_expect_bb1Sim_sub_distinguisherL_le`), by
+  `expect_castImpl_freshImpl`, `expect_handlerMachine` and `abs_expect_runAccept_sub_le`.
+
+## Main definitions
+
+None.
+
+## Main results
+
+* `BB1Machine.abs_expect_bb1Sim_sub_distinguisherL_le` — the simulation against the machine on
+  one Decision BDH tuple.
+
+## References
+
+* [BB04] D. Boneh, X. Boyen, *Efficient Selective-ID Secure Identity Based Encryption Without
+  Random Oracles*, full version, Cryptology ePrint Archive, Report 2004/172, December 2004
+  (extended abstract: EUROCRYPT 2004, LNCS 3027, pp. 223–238). §4.2 (pp. 6–8): the algorithm
+  `B` in the proof of Theorem 4.1.
+* [PS10] R. Pass, a. shelat, *A Course in Cryptography*, lecture notes, 3rd ed., January 2010.
+  (Definition 26.8, non-uniform PPT.)
+-/
+
+namespace TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.IdentityBased
+
+open Complexity Turing TCSlib.Cryptography.Games TCSlib.Cryptography.Pairing
+  TCSlib.Cryptography.Composability TCSlib.Cryptography.Candidates
+
+namespace BB1Machine
+
+variable (G : BilinearGen) (ℓ : PolyExpr)
+
+/-- A cast between bit-vector types of equal widths is the padding of the vector's word. -/
+private theorem cast_eq_padFin {a c : ℕ} (hac : a = c) (h : (Fin a → Bool) = (Fin c → Bool))
+    (f : Fin a → Bool) : cast h f = padFin c (List.ofFn f) := by
+  subst hac
+  rw [cast_eq, padFin_ofFn]
+
+/-- The word of a padded word of the right length: `⟦padFin m ⟦v⟧⟧ = ⟦v⟧` when `|v| = m`. -/
+private theorem ofFn_padFin_ofFn {n m : ℕ} (h : n = m) (v : Fin n → Bool) :
+    List.ofFn (padFin m (List.ofFn v)) = List.ofFn v :=
+  ofFn_padFin_of_length (by rw [List.length_ofFn, h])
+
+/-- The word of a validity bit followed by a key: `⟦decAnswer (some v)⟧ = 1 :: ⟦v⟧`. -/
+private theorem ofFn_decAnswer_some {n : ℕ} (v : Fin n → Bool) :
+    List.ofFn (FixedLengthScheme.decAnswer (some v)) = true :: List.ofFn v := by
+  rw [FixedLengthScheme.decAnswer_some, List.ofFn_succ]
+  simp only [Fin.cons_zero, Fin.cons_succ]
+
+/-- The `KeyGen` answer type of the game, from published readers:
+`(S.sidSpec κ).rng 1 = (Fin (S.skLen.eval κ + 1) → Bool)` (`sidSpec_eq`, `bitSpec_rng`,
+`outLens_one`). -/
+private theorem sidSpec_rng_one' (S : IBEScheme) (κ : ℕ) :
+    (S.sidSpec κ).rng 1 = (Fin (S.skLen.eval κ + 1) → Bool) := by
+  rw [IBEScheme.sidSpec_eq, bitSpec_rng, IBEScheme.outLens_one]
+
+/-- The `Challenge` answer type of the game, from published readers:
+`(S.sidSpec κ).rng 2 = (Fin (S.ctLen.eval κ) → Bool)` (`sidSpec_eq`, `bitSpec_rng`,
+`outLens_two`). -/
+private theorem sidSpec_rng_two' (S : IBEScheme) (κ : ℕ) :
+    (S.sidSpec κ).rng 2 = (Fin (S.ctLen.eval κ) → Bool) := by
+  rw [IBEScheme.sidSpec_eq, bitSpec_rng, IBEScheme.outLens_two]
+
+section Glue
+
+variable (b : Bool) (κ : ℕ) (r : G.gen.Coins κ) (g X Y Z : (G.group κ (G.desc κ r)).G)
+  (T : (G.group κ (G.desc κ r)).GT)
+
+/-- **The simulator's oracles have the law of the oracles with fresh exponents**, call by call: for
+every oracle `i`, query `x`, state `st` and `F`,
+`𝔼[F | bb1SimImpl … i x st] = 𝔼[F | castImpl (freshImpl (drawStep …)) i x st]`, the right side
+being `drawStep` with a fresh uniform exponent, read on the game's lengths.
+
+**Proof sketch.** Unfold both sides one call deep (`bb1SimImpl_eq`, `castImpl_eq`,
+`ETTGame.freshImpl_apply`) and split on the oracle and the state. The game's oracle is read at
+the game's query type by `IBEScheme.oracleImpl_{zero,one,two}_onSpec`, and every cast between
+bit-vector types of equal width is the padding of the vector's word (`cast_eq_padFin`; widths
+from `inLens_*`, `outLens_*`, `qLen_*`, `aLen_*`). In each case (`Init`: parameters drawn or
+recorded; `KeyGen`: before `Init`, the target identity, another identity; `Challenge`: before
+`Init`, a valid or invalid first challenge, a repeated one) the simulator's case lemma
+(`bb1SimInit_*`, `bb1SimKeyQ_*`, `bb1SimChal_*`) and `drawStep`'s case lemma draw the same
+uniform exponent (or none), and the answers have the same words: the parameters by
+`ofFn_bb1Scheme_encPP`, the key by `ofFn_decAnswer_some` and `ofFn_bb1Scheme_encSK`, the
+challenge by `ofFn_bb1SimCt`, the message-space test by `bb1Scheme_msgSpace_iff`, and `⊥` by
+`ofFn_zeroBits`. Vectors with equal words are equal (`ofFn_padFin_of_length`). -/
+private theorem expect_bb1SimImpl (i : Fin 3) (x : ((bb1Scheme G ℓ).sidSpec κ).dom i)
+    (st : BB1SimState G ℓ κ (G.desc κ r))
+    (F : ((bb1Scheme G ℓ).sidSpec κ).rng i × BB1SimState G ℓ κ (G.desc κ r) → ℝ) :
+    ProbComp.expect (bb1SimImpl G ℓ b κ (G.desc κ r) g X Y Z T i x st) F =
+      ProbComp.expect (castImpl (ins := (bb1Scheme G ℓ).inLens κ)
+        (outs := (bb1Scheme G ℓ).outLens κ)
+        (ETTGame.freshImpl (spec := bitSpecAt (BB1Machine.qLen G ℓ) (BB1Machine.aLen G ℓ) κ)
+          (BB1Machine.drawStep G ℓ b κ (G.desc κ r) g X Y Z T)) i x st) F := by
+  rw [bb1SimImpl_eq, castImpl_eq, ETTGame.freshImpl_apply, OracleComp.bind_assoc]
+  obtain ⟨o, c⟩ := st
+  match i, x, F with
+  | 0, x, F =>
+    -- `Init`: the parameters, drawn with a fresh exponent or recorded
+    have hq : (bb1Scheme G ℓ).inLens κ 0 = (BB1Machine.qLen G ℓ 0).eval κ := by
+      rw [IBEScheme.inLens_zero, BB1Machine.qLen_zero]
+    have hx : padFin ((bb1Scheme G ℓ).idLen.eval κ)
+        (List.ofFn (padFin ((BB1Machine.qLen G ℓ 0).eval κ) (List.ofFn x))) =
+        padFin ((bb1Scheme G ℓ).idLen.eval κ) (List.ofFn x) := by
+      rw [ofFn_padFin_ofFn hq]
+    rw [IBEScheme.oracleImpl_zero_onSpec,
+      cast_eq_padFin (IBEScheme.inLens_zero (bb1Scheme G ℓ) κ) _ x]
+    have hlen : ∀ h : (G.group κ (G.desc κ r)).G,
+        (G.desc κ r ++ List.ofFn ((G.group κ (G.desc κ r)).encG g) ++
+          List.ofFn ((G.group κ (G.desc κ r)).encG X) ++
+          List.ofFn ((G.group κ (G.desc κ r)).encG Y) ++
+          List.ofFn ((G.group κ (G.desc κ r)).encG h)).length = (bb1Scheme G ℓ).ppLen.eval κ := by
+      intro h
+      simp only [List.length_append, List.length_ofFn, G.length_desc]
+      rw [bb1Scheme_ppLen, PolyExpr.eval_add, PolyExpr.eval_mul, PolyExpr.eval_const]
+      ring
+    rcases o with _ | ⟨t, α₁⟩
+    · rw [bb1SimInit_none, OracleComp.bind_assoc]
+      simp only [OracleComp.pure_bind, ProbComp.expect_bind, ProbComp.expect_pure,
+        BB1Machine.drawStep_zero, Option.getD_none, hx]
+      refine congrArg _ (funext fun a => congrArg F (Prod.ext ?_ rfl))
+      rw [cast_eq_padFin (IBEScheme.outLens_zero (bb1Scheme G ℓ) κ).symm _ _,
+        ofFn_bb1Scheme_encPP, bb1SimParams_eq, ofFn_padFin_of_length (hlen _),
+        ofFn_padFin_of_length (by rw [hlen, BB1Machine.aLen_zero])]
+    · rw [bb1SimInit_some, OracleComp.pure_bind, ProbComp.expect_pure]
+      simp only [OracleComp.pure_bind, ProbComp.expect_bind, ProbComp.expect_pure,
+        BB1Machine.drawStep_zero, Option.getD_some]
+      rw [ProbComp.expect_const, cast_eq_padFin (IBEScheme.outLens_zero (bb1Scheme G ℓ) κ).symm _ _,
+        ofFn_bb1Scheme_encPP, bb1SimParams_eq, ofFn_padFin_of_length (hlen _),
+        ofFn_padFin_of_length (by rw [hlen, BB1Machine.aLen_zero])]
+  | 1, x, F =>
+    -- `KeyGen`: `⊥` before `Init` and on the target identity, else a key with a fresh exponent
+    have hq : (bb1Scheme G ℓ).inLens κ 1 = (BB1Machine.qLen G ℓ 1).eval κ := by
+      rw [IBEScheme.inLens_one, BB1Machine.qLen_one]
+    have hx : padFin ((bb1Scheme G ℓ).idLen.eval κ)
+        (List.ofFn (padFin ((BB1Machine.qLen G ℓ 1).eval κ) (List.ofFn x))) =
+        padFin ((bb1Scheme G ℓ).idLen.eval κ) (List.ofFn x) := by
+      rw [ofFn_padFin_ofFn hq]
+    have hxl : List.ofFn (padFin ((BB1Machine.qLen G ℓ 1).eval κ) (List.ofFn x)) = List.ofFn x :=
+      ofFn_padFin_ofFn hq x
+    have hidl : (bb1Scheme G ℓ).inLens κ 1 = (bb1Scheme G ℓ).idLen.eval κ :=
+      IBEScheme.inLens_one _ κ
+    have hzero : ∀ e : ℕ, padFin ((bb1Scheme G ℓ).outLens κ 1) (List.ofFn (zeroBits e)) =
+        cast (sidSpec_rng_one' (bb1Scheme G ℓ) κ).symm (zeroBits _) := by
+      intro e
+      rw [cast_eq_padFin (IBEScheme.outLens_one (bb1Scheme G ℓ) κ).symm _ _, ofFn_zeroBits,
+        ofFn_zeroBits, padFin_replicate_false, padFin_replicate_false]
+    rw [IBEScheme.oracleImpl_one_onSpec, cast_eq_padFin hidl _ x]
+    rcases o with _ | ⟨t, α₁⟩
+    · rw [bb1SimKeyQ_none, OracleComp.pure_bind, ProbComp.expect_pure]
+      simp only [OracleComp.pure_bind, ProbComp.expect_bind, ProbComp.expect_pure,
+        BB1Machine.drawStep_one_none]
+      rw [ProbComp.expect_const, hzero]
+    · by_cases ht : List.ofFn x = List.ofFn t
+      · have ht' : padFin ((bb1Scheme G ℓ).idLen.eval κ) (List.ofFn x) = t := by
+          rw [ht, padFin_ofFn]
+        rw [ht', bb1SimKeyQ_target, OracleComp.pure_bind, ProbComp.expect_pure]
+        simp only [OracleComp.pure_bind, ProbComp.expect_bind, ProbComp.expect_pure,
+          BB1Machine.drawStep_one_target G ℓ b κ _ g X Y Z T _ t α₁ c _ (hxl.trans ht)]
+        rw [ProbComp.expect_const, hzero]
+      · have ht' : padFin ((bb1Scheme G ℓ).idLen.eval κ) (List.ofFn x) ≠ t := by
+          intro h
+          apply ht
+          rw [← h, ofFn_padFin_ofFn hidl]
+        rw [bb1SimKeyQ_ne G ℓ κ _ g X Y _ t α₁ c ht', OracleComp.bind_assoc]
+        simp only [OracleComp.pure_bind, ProbComp.expect_bind, ProbComp.expect_pure,
+          BB1Machine.drawStep_one_key G ℓ b κ _ g X Y Z T _ t α₁ c _ (fun h => ht (hxl ▸ h)),
+          hx]
+        refine congrArg _ (funext fun u => congrArg F (Prod.ext ?_ rfl))
+        rw [cast_eq_padFin (IBEScheme.outLens_one (bb1Scheme G ℓ) κ).symm _ _, ofFn_decAnswer_some,
+          ofFn_bb1Scheme_encSK, bb1SimKey_eq, BB1.F_eq, bb1SimParams_eq]
+        have hsk : (List.ofFn ((G.group κ (G.desc κ r)).encG
+            (Y ^ (-α₁ / (BB1.idToZ (G.group κ (G.desc κ r))
+                (padFin ((bb1Scheme G ℓ).idLen.eval κ) (List.ofFn x)) -
+              BB1.idToZ (G.group κ (G.desc κ r)) t)).val *
+            (X ^ (BB1.idToZ (G.group κ (G.desc κ r))
+                (padFin ((bb1Scheme G ℓ).idLen.eval κ) (List.ofFn x))).val *
+              (X ^ (-BB1.idToZ (G.group κ (G.desc κ r)) t).val * g ^ α₁.val)) ^ u.val)) ++
+            List.ofFn ((G.group κ (G.desc κ r)).encG
+              (Y ^ (-1 / (BB1.idToZ (G.group κ (G.desc κ r))
+                (padFin ((bb1Scheme G ℓ).idLen.eval κ) (List.ofFn x)) -
+                BB1.idToZ (G.group κ (G.desc κ r)) t)).val * g ^ u.val))).length =
+            (bb1Scheme G ℓ).skLen.eval κ := by
+          simp only [List.length_append, List.length_ofFn]
+          rw [bb1Scheme_skLen, PolyExpr.eval_mul, PolyExpr.eval_const]
+          ring
+        rw [ofFn_padFin_of_length hsk, ofFn_padFin_of_length (by
+          rw [List.length_cons, hsk, BB1Machine.aLen_one, PolyExpr.eval_add, PolyExpr.eval_const])]
+  | 2, x, F =>
+    -- `Challenge`: `⊥` before `Init` and on invalid messages, else the recorded challenge
+    have hq : (bb1Scheme G ℓ).inLens κ 2 = (BB1Machine.qLen G ℓ 2).eval κ := by
+      rw [IBEScheme.inLens_two, BB1Machine.qLen_two, PolyExpr.eval_add]
+    have hxl : List.ofFn (padFin ((BB1Machine.qLen G ℓ 2).eval κ) (List.ofFn x)) = List.ofFn x :=
+      ofFn_padFin_ofFn hq x
+    have hml : (bb1Scheme G ℓ).inLens κ 2 =
+        (bb1Scheme G ℓ).msgLen.eval κ + (bb1Scheme G ℓ).msgLen.eval κ :=
+      IBEScheme.inLens_two _ κ
+    have hmm : List.ofFn (padFin ((bb1Scheme G ℓ).msgLen.eval κ + (bb1Scheme G ℓ).msgLen.eval κ)
+        (List.ofFn x)) = List.ofFn x := ofFn_padFin_ofFn hml x
+    have hzero : ∀ e : ℕ, padFin ((bb1Scheme G ℓ).outLens κ 2) (List.ofFn (zeroBits e)) =
+        cast (sidSpec_rng_two' (bb1Scheme G ℓ) κ).symm (zeroBits _) := by
+      intro e
+      rw [cast_eq_padFin (IBEScheme.outLens_two (bb1Scheme G ℓ) κ).symm _ _, ofFn_zeroBits,
+        ofFn_zeroBits, padFin_replicate_false, padFin_replicate_false]
+    rw [IBEScheme.oracleImpl_two_onSpec, cast_eq_padFin hml _ x]
+    rcases o with _ | ⟨t, α₁⟩
+    · rw [bb1SimChal_none, OracleComp.pure_bind, ProbComp.expect_pure]
+      simp only [OracleComp.pure_bind, ProbComp.expect_bind, ProbComp.expect_pure,
+        BB1Machine.drawStep_two_none]
+      rw [ProbComp.expect_const, hzero]
+    · rcases c with _ | w
+      · -- the halves of the query, read in the game and by `drawStep`
+        have h1 : List.ofFn (FixedLengthScheme.splitHalf (padFin ((bb1Scheme G ℓ).msgLen.eval κ +
+            (bb1Scheme G ℓ).msgLen.eval κ) (List.ofFn x))).1 =
+            (List.ofFn x).take ((bb1Scheme G ℓ).msgLen.eval κ) := by
+          rw [FixedLengthScheme.ofFn_splitHalf_fst, hmm]
+        have h2 : List.ofFn (FixedLengthScheme.splitHalf (padFin ((bb1Scheme G ℓ).msgLen.eval κ +
+            (bb1Scheme G ℓ).msgLen.eval κ) (List.ofFn x))).2 =
+            (List.ofFn x).drop ((bb1Scheme G ℓ).msgLen.eval κ) := by
+          rw [FixedLengthScheme.ofFn_splitHalf_snd, hmm]
+        by_cases hc : (∃ v, List.ofFn ((G.group κ (G.desc κ r)).encT v) =
+              (List.ofFn x).take ((bb1Scheme G ℓ).msgLen.eval κ)) ∧
+            (∃ v, List.ofFn ((G.group κ (G.desc κ r)).encT v) =
+              (List.ofFn x).drop ((bb1Scheme G ℓ).msgLen.eval κ))
+        · have hc1 := (bb1Scheme_msgSpace_iff G ℓ κ (G.desc κ r) (bb1SimParams G ℓ g X Y t α₁)
+            (FixedLengthScheme.splitHalf (padFin ((bb1Scheme G ℓ).msgLen.eval κ +
+              (bb1Scheme G ℓ).msgLen.eval κ) (List.ofFn x))).1).2 (by rw [h1]; exact hc.1)
+          have hc2 := (bb1Scheme_msgSpace_iff G ℓ κ (G.desc κ r) (bb1SimParams G ℓ g X Y t α₁)
+            (FixedLengthScheme.splitHalf (padFin ((bb1Scheme G ℓ).msgLen.eval κ +
+              (bb1Scheme G ℓ).msgLen.eval κ) (List.ofFn x))).2).2 (by rw [h2]; exact hc.2)
+          rw [bb1SimChal_fresh G ℓ b κ _ g X Y Z T _ t α₁ ⟨hc1, hc2⟩, OracleComp.pure_bind,
+            ProbComp.expect_pure]
+          simp only [OracleComp.pure_bind, ProbComp.expect_bind, ProbComp.expect_pure,
+            BB1Machine.drawStep_two_fresh G ℓ b κ _ g X Y Z T _ t α₁ _ (hxl ▸ hc), hxl]
+          rw [ProbComp.expect_const]
+          -- the challenge words agree
+          have hsel : List.ofFn (if b then (FixedLengthScheme.splitHalf
+              (padFin ((bb1Scheme G ℓ).msgLen.eval κ + (bb1Scheme G ℓ).msgLen.eval κ)
+                (List.ofFn x))).2 else (FixedLengthScheme.splitHalf
+              (padFin ((bb1Scheme G ℓ).msgLen.eval κ + (bb1Scheme G ℓ).msgLen.eval κ)
+                (List.ofFn x))).1) =
+              if b then (List.ofFn x).drop ((bb1Scheme G ℓ).msgLen.eval κ)
+              else (List.ofFn x).take ((bb1Scheme G ℓ).msgLen.eval κ) := by
+            cases b
+            · exact h1
+            · exact h2
+          have hct := ofFn_bb1SimCt G ℓ κ (G.desc κ r) Z T α₁
+            (if b then (FixedLengthScheme.splitHalf
+              (padFin ((bb1Scheme G ℓ).msgLen.eval κ + (bb1Scheme G ℓ).msgLen.eval κ)
+                (List.ofFn x))).2 else (FixedLengthScheme.splitHalf
+              (padFin ((bb1Scheme G ℓ).msgLen.eval κ + (bb1Scheme G ℓ).msgLen.eval κ)
+                (List.ofFn x))).1)
+          rw [hsel] at hct
+          have hrec := List.ofFn_injective (hct.trans rfl)
+          refine congrArg F (Prod.ext ?_ (congrArg (fun w => (some (t, α₁), some w)) hrec))
+          rw [cast_eq_padFin (IBEScheme.outLens_two (bb1Scheme G ℓ) κ).symm _ _, hrec,
+            ofFn_padFin_of_length, ofFn_padFin_of_length]
+          · simp only [List.length_append, List.length_ofFn]
+            rw [BB1Machine.aLen_two, bb1Scheme_ctLen, PolyExpr.eval_add, PolyExpr.eval_mul,
+              PolyExpr.eval_const]
+            ring
+          · simp only [List.length_append, List.length_ofFn]
+            rw [bb1Scheme_ctLen, PolyExpr.eval_add, PolyExpr.eval_mul, PolyExpr.eval_const]
+            ring
+        · rw [bb1SimChal_invalid G ℓ b κ _ g X Y Z T
+            (padFin ((bb1Scheme G ℓ).msgLen.eval κ + (bb1Scheme G ℓ).msgLen.eval κ) (List.ofFn x))
+            t α₁ (fun h => hc ⟨h1 ▸ (bb1Scheme_msgSpace_iff G ℓ κ (G.desc κ r)
+              (bb1SimParams G ℓ g X Y t α₁) _).1 h.1, h2 ▸ (bb1Scheme_msgSpace_iff G ℓ κ
+              (G.desc κ r) (bb1SimParams G ℓ g X Y t α₁) _).1 h.2⟩), OracleComp.pure_bind,
+            ProbComp.expect_pure]
+          simp only [OracleComp.pure_bind, ProbComp.expect_bind, ProbComp.expect_pure,
+            BB1Machine.drawStep_two_invalid G ℓ b κ _ g X Y Z T _ t α₁ _ (hxl ▸ hc)]
+          rw [ProbComp.expect_const, hzero]
+      · rw [bb1SimChal_repeat G ℓ b κ _ g X Y Z T _ (t, α₁) w, OracleComp.pure_bind,
+          ProbComp.expect_pure]
+        simp only [OracleComp.pure_bind, ProbComp.expect_bind, ProbComp.expect_pure,
+          BB1Machine.drawStep_two_repeat]
+        rw [ProbComp.expect_const,
+          cast_eq_padFin (IBEScheme.outLens_two (bb1Scheme G ℓ) κ).symm _ _,
+          ofFn_padFin_ofFn (by rw [BB1Machine.aLen_two])]
+
+end Glue
+
+/-- **The simulation and the machine on one Decision BDH tuple**: with arithmetic `H`, operations
+`O`, an adversary `A`, its `toCompOn` form `A'`, budget `q`, bit `b`, security parameter `κ`, a
+coin bijection `φ'` with `A'.toCompOn codec κ q x (φ' ρ) = A.toComp codec κ q ρ` (`hφ'`), and a
+machine `B` realizing `handler … b q` for `A'` (coin bijection `φ`, `hφ`: the conclusion of T1),
+for the generator's coins `r` and every tuple `(g, X, Y, Z, T)`,
+`|𝔼_{ρ ← A.Coins} 𝔼[[guess = 1] | simulate (bb1SimImpl … b κ d g X Y Z T)
+(A.toComp sidCodec κ q(κ) ρ) (⊥, ⊥)] −
+Pr_{ρ ← B.Coins}[B.distinguisherL κ ⟨d, g, X, Y, Z, T⟩ ρ]| ≤ q(κ) · (1/2)^n`, with
+`d = desc(κ, r)` and `n = blockLen(κ)`.
+
+**Proof sketch.** Call by call, `bb1SimImpl` has the law of `drawStep` with fresh exponents read
+on the game's lengths (`expect_bb1SimImpl`), so the run against the simulator has the law of the
+run against `castImpl (freshImpl drawStep)` (`ProbComp.expect_simulate_congr`). By `hφ'` and
+`sidCodec_eq` it is the run of `A'`, which accepts with `𝔼_U runAccept (φ' ρ) U`
+(`expect_castImpl_freshImpl`). The machine accepts with `𝔼_ρ 𝔼_V runAccept ρ (draw ∘ V)`
+(`expect_handlerMachine`). Move `A`'s coins to `A'`'s along `φ'` (`expect_sample_equiv`), and
+conclude by `abs_expect_runAccept_sub_le`. -/
+theorem abs_expect_bb1Sim_sub_distinguisherL_le (H : ArithmeticFP) (O : G.Ops) (A A' : NUPPT)
+    (q : PolyExpr) (b : Bool) (κ : ℕ) (φ' : A.Coins κ ≃ A'.Coins κ)
+    (hφ' : ∀ {ι α : Type} {spec : OracleSpec ι} (codec : MachineCodec spec α) (q : ℕ)
+      (x : List Bool) (r : A.Coins κ), A'.toCompOn codec κ q x (φ' r) = A.toComp codec κ q r)
+    (B : NUPPT)
+    (φ : (Fin ((BB1Machine.handler G ℓ O b q H).seedLen.eval κ) → Bool) × A'.Coins κ ≃ B.Coins κ)
+    (hφ : ∀ (z : List Bool) (ω : Fin ((BB1Machine.handler G ℓ O b q H).seedLen.eval κ) → Bool)
+      (ρ : A'.Coins κ), ∃ (a : Fin ((PolyExpr.const 1).eval κ) → Bool)
+        (s : Fin ((BB1Machine.handler G ℓ O b q H).stateLen.eval κ) → Bool),
+        simulate ((BB1Machine.handler G ℓ O b q H).impl κ z ω)
+            (A'.toCompOn (bitCodec (fun i => (BB1Machine.qLen G ℓ i).eval κ)
+              (fun i => (BB1Machine.aLen G ℓ i).eval κ) ((PolyExpr.const 1).eval κ)) κ (q.eval κ)
+              ((BB1Machine.handler G ℓ O b q H).advInput κ z ω) ρ)
+            ((BB1Machine.handler G ℓ O b q H).init κ) = .pure (a, s) ∧
+          B.runAt κ z (φ (ω, ρ)) = (BB1Machine.handler G ℓ O b q H).result κ z ω s a)
+    (r : G.gen.Coins κ) (g X Y Z : (G.group κ (G.desc κ r)).G)
+    (T : (G.group κ (G.desc κ r)).GT) :
+    |ProbComp.expect (ProbComp.sample (A.Coins κ)) (fun ρ =>
+        ProbComp.expect (simulate (bb1SimImpl G ℓ b κ (G.desc κ r) g X Y Z T)
+          (A.toComp ((bb1Scheme G ℓ).sidCodec κ) κ (q.eval κ) ρ) (none, none))
+          (fun res => if res.1 0 = true then 1 else 0)) -
+      ProbComp.expect (ProbComp.sample (B.Coins κ)) (fun ρ => if B.distinguisherL κ
+        (tupleStr (G.group κ (G.desc κ r)) (G.desc κ r) g X Y Z T) ρ = true then 1 else 0)| ≤
+      q.eval κ * (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ (BB1Machine.blockLen G).eval κ := by
+  have hid : (fun ρ => ProbComp.expect (simulate (bb1SimImpl G ℓ b κ (G.desc κ r) g X Y Z T)
+      (A.toComp ((bb1Scheme G ℓ).sidCodec κ) κ (q.eval κ) ρ) (none, none))
+      (fun res => if res.1 0 = true then (1 : ℝ) else 0)) = fun ρ =>
+      ProbComp.expect (ProbComp.sample (Fin (q.eval κ) → ZMod (G.group κ (G.desc κ r)).order))
+        fun U => BB1Machine.runAccept G ℓ b q A' κ r g X Y Z T (φ' ρ) U := by
+    funext ρ
+    rw [ProbComp.expect_simulate_congr _ _ (expect_bb1SimImpl G ℓ b κ r g X Y Z T),
+      ← hφ' ((bb1Scheme G ℓ).sidCodec κ) (q.eval κ) [] ρ, IBEScheme.sidCodec_eq,
+      BB1Machine.expect_castImpl_freshImpl]
+  have e := ProbComp.expect_sample_equiv φ' (fun ρ => ProbComp.expect (ProbComp.sample
+    (Fin (q.eval κ) → ZMod (G.group κ (G.desc κ r)).order))
+      fun U => BB1Machine.runAccept G ℓ b q A' κ r g X Y Z T ρ U)
+  beta_reduce at e
+  rw [hid, BB1Machine.expect_handlerMachine G ℓ b q A' κ r g X Y Z T O H B φ hφ, e,
+    abs_sub_comm]
+  exact BB1Machine.abs_expect_runAccept_sub_le G ℓ b q A' κ r g X Y Z T
+
+end BB1Machine
+
+end TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.IdentityBased
diff --git a/TCSlib/Cryptography/AdvancedEncryption/IdentityBased/BonehBoyenMachine/Reduction.lean b/TCSlib/Cryptography/AdvancedEncryption/IdentityBased/BonehBoyenMachine/Reduction.lean

+import TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.IdentityBased.BonehBoyenMachine.Handler
+
+set_option maxHeartbeats 0
+set_option relaxedAutoImplicit false
+set_option autoImplicit false
+
+/-!
+# The reduction machine's acceptance and the simulator with drawn exponents
+
+Helper module of `AdvancedEncryption/IdentityBased/BonehBoyenMachine.lean` (step 3 of
+[BB04, proof of Theorem 4.1] at depth `ℓ = 1`). Fix the group described by `d = desc(κ, r)`, the
+Decision BDH tuple `(g, X, Y, Z, T)` and the coins `ρ` of an adversary `A'` run through the handler
+codec on the empty input. `runAccept … ρ U` is the indicator that `A'` outputs `1` when its
+queries are answered by `drawStep` with the exponent of the `j`-th query read from a tape `U j`
+(`ETTGame.tapeImpl`). Then:
+* the machine of the handler theorem T1 for `handler` accepts the Decision BDH string with the
+  average of `runAccept` over its coins and the tape of drawn exponents `j ↦ draw (block j)`
+  (`expect_handlerMachine`);
+* the simulator with fresh uniform exponents per query (`ETTGame.freshImpl` of `drawStep`), read
+  on the game's oracle lengths (`Games.castImpl`), outputs `1` with the average of `runAccept`
+  over a uniform tape of `q(κ)` exponents (`expect_castImpl_freshImpl`): coins in advance have
+  the law of fresh coins (`ETTGame.expect_simulate_tapeImpl`);
+* the two averages differ by at most `q(κ) · (1/2)^n` (`abs_expect_runAccept_sub_le`, from
+  `abs_expect_draws_sub_le`: `runAccept` has values `0` and `1`, the run being deterministic).
+
+## Main definitions
+
+* `BB1Machine.runAccept` — the indicator of output `1` of the run with a tape of exponents.
+
+## Main results
+
+* `BB1Machine.runAccept_eq_zero_or_one`.
+* `BB1Machine.expect_handlerMachine`, `BB1Machine.expect_castImpl_freshImpl`,
+  `BB1Machine.abs_expect_runAccept_sub_le`.
+
+## References
+
+* [BB04] D. Boneh, X. Boyen, *Efficient Selective-ID Secure Identity Based Encryption Without
+  Random Oracles*, full version, Cryptology ePrint Archive, Report 2004/172, December 2004
+  (extended abstract: EUROCRYPT 2004, LNCS 3027, pp. 223–238). §4.2 (pp. 6–8): the algorithm
+  `B` in the proof of Theorem 4.1.
+* [PS10] R. Pass, a. shelat, *A Course in Cryptography*, lecture notes, 3rd ed., January 2010.
+  (Definition 26.8, non-uniform PPT.)
+-/
+
+namespace TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.IdentityBased
+
+open Complexity Turing TCSlib.Cryptography.Games TCSlib.Cryptography.Pairing
+  TCSlib.Cryptography.Composability TCSlib.Cryptography.Candidates
+
+namespace BB1Machine
+
+variable (G : BilinearGen) (ℓ : PolyExpr) (b : Bool) (q : PolyExpr) (A' : NUPPT) (κ : ℕ)
+  (r : G.gen.Coins κ) (g X Y Z : (G.group κ (G.desc κ r)).G) (T : (G.group κ (G.desc κ r)).GT)
+
+/-- **The run with a tape of exponents accepts**: `1` if `A'` (coins `ρ`, empty input, budget
+`q(κ)`, the handler's codec) outputs the bit `1` when its queries are answered by `drawStep` with
+the exponent of the `j`-th query read from the tape `U` (`ETTGame.tapeImpl`, extended beyond
+`q(κ)` by `AdaptiveCPA.extTape`), from the empty state, and `0` otherwise (as an expectation). -/
+noncomputable def runAccept (ρ : A'.Coins κ)
+    (U : Fin (q.eval κ) → ZMod (G.group κ (G.desc κ r)).order) : ℝ :=
+  ProbComp.expect (simulate (ETTGame.tapeImpl (spec := bitSpecAt (qLen G ℓ) (aLen G ℓ) κ)
+      (drawStep G ℓ b κ (G.desc κ r) g X Y Z T) (AdaptiveCPA.extTape U))
+      (A'.toCompOn (bitCodec (fun i => (qLen G ℓ i).eval κ) (fun i => (aLen G ℓ i).eval κ)
+        ((PolyExpr.const 1).eval κ)) κ (q.eval κ) [] ρ) ((none, none), 0))
+    fun p => if List.ofFn p.1 = [true] then 1 else 0
+
+/-- `runAccept … ρ U` is the expectation of `[⟦output⟧ = [1]]` over the run of `A'` against
+`drawStep` with the tape `extTape U`. -/
+theorem runAccept_eq (ρ : A'.Coins κ)
+    (U : Fin (q.eval κ) → ZMod (G.group κ (G.desc κ r)).order) :
+    runAccept G ℓ b q A' κ r g X Y Z T ρ U =
+      ProbComp.expect (simulate (ETTGame.tapeImpl (spec := bitSpecAt (qLen G ℓ) (aLen G ℓ) κ)
+          (drawStep G ℓ b κ (G.desc κ r) g X Y Z T) (AdaptiveCPA.extTape U))
+          (A'.toCompOn (bitCodec (fun i => (qLen G ℓ i).eval κ) (fun i => (aLen G ℓ i).eval κ)
+            ((PolyExpr.const 1).eval κ)) κ (q.eval κ) [] ρ) ((none, none), 0))
+        fun p => if List.ofFn p.1 = [true] then 1 else 0 :=
+  rfl
+
+/-- **The run with a tape is deterministic**, so `runAccept` is `0` or `1`
+(`exists_simulate_tape_eq_pure`). -/
+theorem runAccept_eq_zero_or_one (ρ : A'.Coins κ)
+    (U : Fin (q.eval κ) → ZMod (G.group κ (G.desc κ r)).order) :
+    runAccept G ℓ b q A' κ r g X Y Z T ρ U = 0 ∨ runAccept G ℓ b q A' κ r g X Y Z T ρ U = 1 := by
+  obtain ⟨a, st, h⟩ := exists_simulate_tape_eq_pure G ℓ b κ (G.desc κ r) g X Y Z T
+    (AdaptiveCPA.extTape U)
+    (A'.toCompOn (bitCodec (fun i => (qLen G ℓ i).eval κ) (fun i => (aLen G ℓ i).eval κ)
+      ((PolyExpr.const 1).eval κ)) κ (q.eval κ) [] ρ) ((none, none), 0)
+  rw [runAccept_eq, h, ProbComp.expect_pure]
+  by_cases ha : List.ofFn a = [true]
+  · exact Or.inr (if_pos ha)
+  · exact Or.inl (if_neg ha)
+
+variable (O : G.Ops) (H : ArithmeticFP)
+
+/-- **The machine of T1 accepts with the average of `runAccept` over drawn exponents**: if `B` with
+the coin bijection `φ` realizes the handler `handler … b q` for `A'` (the conclusion of T1,
+`Games.exists_handlerMachine`), then `B` accepts the Decision BDH string of `(g, X, Y, Z, T)` with
+probability `𝔼_{ρ} 𝔼_{V} runAccept ρ (j ↦ draw (V j))`, `V` uniform over `q(κ)` blocks of
+`n · n` coins.
+
+**Proof sketch.** Move `B`'s coins to `(ω, ρ)` along `φ` (`expect_sample_equiv`). For fixed coins,
+T1 makes `B`'s output the adversary's output `a` of the handler's run (`handler_result`), and the
+handler's run is the run of `drawStep` with exponents from the seed blocks
+(`simulate_handler`), so `[B accepts] = runAccept ρ (j ↦ draw (block j of ω))`. Split the uniform
+pair (`Bridge.expect_sample_pair`), exchange the samples (`expect_sample_comm`) and read the seed as
+its blocks (`seedBlocks`, `expect_sample_equiv`). -/
+theorem expect_handlerMachine (B : NUPPT)
+    (φ : (Fin ((handler G ℓ O b q H).seedLen.eval κ) → Bool) × A'.Coins κ ≃ B.Coins κ)
+    (hφ : ∀ (z : List Bool) (ω : Fin ((handler G ℓ O b q H).seedLen.eval κ) → Bool)
+      (ρ : A'.Coins κ), ∃ (a : Fin ((PolyExpr.const 1).eval κ) → Bool)
+        (s : Fin ((handler G ℓ O b q H).stateLen.eval κ) → Bool),
+        simulate ((handler G ℓ O b q H).impl κ z ω)
+            (A'.toCompOn (bitCodec (fun i => (qLen G ℓ i).eval κ) (fun i => (aLen G ℓ i).eval κ)
+              ((PolyExpr.const 1).eval κ)) κ (q.eval κ) ((handler G ℓ O b q H).advInput κ z ω) ρ)
+            ((handler G ℓ O b q H).init κ) = .pure (a, s) ∧
+          B.runAt κ z (φ (ω, ρ)) = (handler G ℓ O b q H).result κ z ω s a) :
+    ProbComp.expect (ProbComp.sample (B.Coins κ))
+        (fun ρ => if B.distinguisherL κ
+          (tupleStr (G.group κ (G.desc κ r)) (G.desc κ r) g X Y Z T) ρ = true then 1 else 0) =
+      ProbComp.expect (ProbComp.sample (A'.Coins κ)) fun ρ =>
+        ProbComp.expect (ProbComp.sample (Fin (q.eval κ) →
+            Fin ((blockLen G).eval κ * (blockLen G).eval κ) → Bool))
+          fun V => runAccept G ℓ b q A' κ r g X Y Z T ρ fun j => draw G κ (G.desc κ r) (V j) := by
+  have hpt : ∀ x : (Fin ((handler G ℓ O b q H).seedLen.eval κ) → Bool) × A'.Coins κ,
+      (if B.distinguisherL κ (tupleStr (G.group κ (G.desc κ r)) (G.desc κ r) g X Y Z T)
+          (φ x) = true then (1 : ℝ) else 0) =
+        runAccept G ℓ b q A' κ r g X Y Z T x.2
+          fun j => draw G κ (G.desc κ r) (seedBlocks G ℓ O b q H κ x.1 j) := by
+    rintro ⟨ω, ρ⟩
+    obtain ⟨a, s, hsim, hrun⟩ :=
+      hφ (tupleStr (G.group κ (G.desc κ r)) (G.desc κ r) g X Y Z T) ω ρ
+    rw [handler_advInput] at hsim
+    obtain ⟨f, hf⟩ := simulate_handler G ℓ O b q H κ r g X Y Z T ω
+      (A'.toCompOn (bitCodec (fun i => (qLen G ℓ i).eval κ) (fun i => (aLen G ℓ i).eval κ)
+        ((PolyExpr.const 1).eval κ)) κ (q.eval κ) [] ρ)
+      (NUPPT.toCompOn_costBoundedBy _ _ _ _ _ _)
+    rw [hf] at hsim
+    have he := congrArg (fun c => ProbComp.expect c
+      (fun p => if List.ofFn p.1 = [true] then (1 : ℝ) else 0)) hsim
+    simp only [ProbComp.expect_bind, ProbComp.expect_pure] at he
+    rw [runAccept_eq, he, NUPPT.distinguisherL_eq, hrun, handler_result]
+    simp only [decide_eq_true_eq]
+  -- the uniform pair `(ω, ρ)` in sequence
+  have hpair : ∀ F : (Fin ((handler G ℓ O b q H).seedLen.eval κ) → Bool) × A'.Coins κ → ℝ,
+      ProbComp.expect (ProbComp.sample
+          ((Fin ((handler G ℓ O b q H).seedLen.eval κ) → Bool) × A'.Coins κ)) F =
+        ProbComp.expect (ProbComp.sample (Fin ((handler G ℓ O b q H).seedLen.eval κ) → Bool))
+          fun ω => ProbComp.expect (ProbComp.sample (A'.Coins κ)) fun ρ => F (ω, ρ) := by
+    intro F
+    rw [← Bridge.expect_sample_pair, ProbComp.expect_bind]
+    simp only [ProbComp.expect_bind, ProbComp.expect_pure]
+  calc ProbComp.expect (ProbComp.sample (B.Coins κ))
+        (fun ρ => if B.distinguisherL κ
+          (tupleStr (G.group κ (G.desc κ r)) (G.desc κ r) g X Y Z T) ρ = true then 1 else 0)
+      = ProbComp.expect (ProbComp.sample
+          ((Fin ((handler G ℓ O b q H).seedLen.eval κ) → Bool) × A'.Coins κ))
+          (fun x => if B.distinguisherL κ
+            (tupleStr (G.group κ (G.desc κ r)) (G.desc κ r) g X Y Z T) (φ x) = true then 1
+            else 0) :=
+        (ProbComp.expect_sample_equiv φ (fun ρ => if B.distinguisherL κ
+          (tupleStr (G.group κ (G.desc κ r)) (G.desc κ r) g X Y Z T) ρ = true then
+            (1 : ℝ) else 0)).symm
+    _ = ProbComp.expect (ProbComp.sample
+          ((Fin ((handler G ℓ O b q H).seedLen.eval κ) → Bool) × A'.Coins κ))
+          (fun x => runAccept G ℓ b q A' κ r g X Y Z T x.2
+            fun j => draw G κ (G.desc κ r) (seedBlocks G ℓ O b q H κ x.1 j)) :=
+        congrArg _ (funext hpt)
+    _ = ProbComp.expect (ProbComp.sample (Fin ((handler G ℓ O b q H).seedLen.eval κ) → Bool))
+          (fun ω => ProbComp.expect (ProbComp.sample (A'.Coins κ)) fun ρ =>
+            runAccept G ℓ b q A' κ r g X Y Z T ρ
+              fun j => draw G κ (G.desc κ r) (seedBlocks G ℓ O b q H κ ω j)) := hpair _
+    _ = ProbComp.expect (ProbComp.sample (A'.Coins κ)) (fun ρ =>
+          ProbComp.expect (ProbComp.sample (Fin ((handler G ℓ O b q H).seedLen.eval κ) → Bool))
+            fun ω => runAccept G ℓ b q A' κ r g X Y Z T ρ
+              fun j => draw G κ (G.desc κ r) (seedBlocks G ℓ O b q H κ ω j)) :=
+        ProbComp.expect_sample_comm _
+    _ = _ := congrArg _ (funext fun ρ => ProbComp.expect_sample_equiv (seedBlocks G ℓ O b q H κ)
+          (fun V => runAccept G ℓ b q A' κ r g X Y Z T ρ fun j => draw G κ (G.desc κ r) (V j)))
+
+/-- The output bit read as a word: `[a 0 = 1] = [⟦a⟧ = [1]]` for a one-bit output `a`. -/
+private theorem ite_ofFn_one {σ : Type} :
+    (fun p : (Fin 1 → Bool) × σ => if p.1 0 = true then (1 : ℝ) else 0) =
+      fun p => (fun lp : List Bool × σ => if lp.1 = [true] then (1 : ℝ) else 0)
+        (List.ofFn p.1, p.2) := by
+  funext p
+  simp only [List.ofFn_succ, List.ofFn_zero, List.cons.injEq, and_true]
+
+/-- **The simulator with fresh exponents accepts with the average of `runAccept` over uniform
+exponents**: the run of `A'` on the game's oracle lengths against the oracles of `drawStep` with
+a fresh uniform exponent per query, read on the game's lengths (`castImpl` of
+`ETTGame.freshImpl`), outputs `1` with probability `𝔼_{U ← Z_p^{q(κ)}} runAccept ρ U`.
+
+**Proof sketch.** Transport the run to the handler's lengths, which are the game's
+(`expect_simulate_castImpl_toCompOn` with `qLen_eval`, `aLen_eval`), then draw the exponents in
+advance (`ETTGame.expect_simulate_tapeImpl`: `A'` makes at most `q(κ)` queries,
+`NUPPT.toCompOn_costBoundedBy`). -/
+theorem expect_castImpl_freshImpl (ρ : A'.Coins κ) :
+    ProbComp.expect (simulate (castImpl (ins := (bb1Scheme G ℓ).inLens κ)
+        (outs := (bb1Scheme G ℓ).outLens κ)
+        (ETTGame.freshImpl (spec := bitSpecAt (qLen G ℓ) (aLen G ℓ) κ)
+          (drawStep G ℓ b κ (G.desc κ r) g X Y Z T)))
+        (A'.toCompOn (bitCodec ((bb1Scheme G ℓ).inLens κ) ((bb1Scheme G ℓ).outLens κ) 1) κ
+          (q.eval κ) [] ρ) (none, none))
+      (fun p => if p.1 0 = true then 1 else 0) =
+      ProbComp.expect (ProbComp.sample (Fin (q.eval κ) → ZMod (G.group κ (G.desc κ r)).order))
+        fun U => runAccept G ℓ b q A' κ r g X Y Z T ρ U := by
+  rw [ite_ofFn_one]
+  refine (expect_simulate_castImpl_toCompOn (qLen_eval G ℓ κ).symm
+    (aLen_eval G ℓ κ).symm (PolyExpr.eval_const 1 κ).symm
+    (ETTGame.freshImpl (spec := bitSpecAt (qLen G ℓ) (aLen G ℓ) κ)
+      (drawStep G ℓ b κ (G.desc κ r) g X Y Z T)) A' κ (q.eval κ) [] ρ (none, none)
+    (fun lp => if lp.1 = [true] then (1 : ℝ) else 0)).trans ?_
+  exact (ETTGame.expect_simulate_tapeImpl (spec := bitSpecAt (qLen G ℓ) (aLen G ℓ) κ)
+    (drawStep G ℓ b κ (G.desc κ r) g X Y Z T) (q.eval κ)
+    (fun a => if List.ofFn a = [true] then (1 : ℝ) else 0)
+    (A'.toCompOn (bitCodec (fun i => (qLen G ℓ i).eval κ) (fun i => (aLen G ℓ i).eval κ)
+      ((PolyExpr.const 1).eval κ)) κ (q.eval κ) [] ρ) (q.eval κ)
+    (NUPPT.toCompOn_costBoundedBy _ _ _ _ _ _) (none, none) 0 (by omega)).symm
+
+/-- **Drawn exponents against uniform ones**: averaged over the adversary's coins,
+`|𝔼_ρ 𝔼_V runAccept ρ (draw ∘ V) − 𝔼_ρ 𝔼_U runAccept ρ U| ≤ q(κ) · (1/2)^n`
+(`abs_expect_draws_sub_le` for each `ρ`, `runAccept` having values `0` and `1`). -/
+theorem abs_expect_runAccept_sub_le :
+    |ProbComp.expect (ProbComp.sample (A'.Coins κ)) (fun ρ =>
+        ProbComp.expect (ProbComp.sample (Fin (q.eval κ) →
+            Fin ((blockLen G).eval κ * (blockLen G).eval κ) → Bool))
+          fun V => runAccept G ℓ b q A' κ r g X Y Z T ρ fun j => draw G κ (G.desc κ r) (V j)) -
+      ProbComp.expect (ProbComp.sample (A'.Coins κ)) (fun ρ =>
+        ProbComp.expect (ProbComp.sample (Fin (q.eval κ) → ZMod (G.group κ (G.desc κ r)).order))
+          fun U => runAccept G ℓ b q A' κ r g X Y Z T ρ U)| ≤
+      q.eval κ * (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ (blockLen G).eval κ :=
+  ProbComp.abs_expect_sub_le _ fun ρ => abs_expect_draws_sub_le G κ (G.desc κ r) (q.eval κ)
+    (runAccept G ℓ b q A' κ r g X Y Z T ρ) (runAccept_eq_zero_or_one G ℓ b q A' κ r g X Y Z T ρ)
+
+end BB1Machine
+
+end TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.IdentityBased

+import TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.IdentityBased.BonehBoyenMachine.Draws
+import TCSlib.Cryptography.Games.Efficiency
+import TCSlib.Cryptography.Pairing.Assumptions
+import TCSlib.Cryptography.Pairing.Operations
+
+set_option maxHeartbeats 0
+set_option relaxedAutoImplicit false
+set_option autoImplicit false
+
+/-!
+# The string layer of the BB1 reduction handler
+
+Helper module of `AdvancedEncryption/IdentityBased/BonehBoyenMachine.lean` (step 3 of
+[BB04, proof of Theorem 4.1] at depth `ℓ = 1`): the string functions from which the handler of
+`BonehBoyenMachine/Handler.lean` is assembled, each polynomial-time, with its value on the inputs
+the handler sees.
+
+**The round input.** One round of the handler (`Games.PolyHandler`) reads
+`w = ⟨⟨1^κ, ⟨z, ω⟩⟩, ⟨s, ⟨1^i, x⟩⟩⟩` (`PolyHandler.input`): the parameter, the reduction input
+`z = ⟨d, ⟨g, ⟨X, ⟨Y, ⟨Z, T⟩⟩⟩⟩⟩` (`Pairing.tupleStr`), the seed `ω`, the state
+`s = ⟨1^j, ⟨o_1, o_2⟩⟩` (padded), the oracle index and the query. The readers are named after the
+field they read: `rU`, `rZ`, `rW`, `rS`, `rI`, `rX` (the round input), `zD`, …, `zT` (the tuple),
+`sJ`, `sO1`, `sR`, `sCom`, `sChal`, `sC`, `sO2`, `kT`, `kA` (the state).
+
+**Arithmetic and groups.** Residues modulo the order `p = ⟦orderStr d⟧` are binary numerals:
+`modS`, `negS`, `addS`, `mulS`, `invS` compute `a mod p`, `−a`, `a + c`, `a · c`, `a⁻¹` (`0⁻¹ = 0`)
+with the functions of `Candidates.ArithmeticFP` (negation through truncated subtraction of the
+reduced residue from `p`, then a reduction); `mulGS`, `powGS` are the operations of `G` of the
+contract `Pairing.BilinearGen.Ops`. `uS` draws the exponent of the query from block `j` of the
+seed by `Candidates.sampleBelowL` and writes it with `wG(κ) + 1` bits.
+
+## Main definitions
+
+* `BB1Machine.aWidth`, `BB1Machine.nn` — the widths `wG + 1` and `n · n`.
+* `BB1Machine.rU`, …, `BB1Machine.kA` — the readers of the round input.
+* `BB1Machine.pS`, `modS`, `negS`, `addS`, `mulS`, `invS`, `mulGS`, `powGS` — arithmetic.
+* `BB1Machine.blkS`, `BB1Machine.uS` — the block of the query and its exponent.
+
+## Main results
+
+* `BB1Machine.poly_rU`, …, `BB1Machine.poly_uS` — polynomial time.
+* `BB1Machine.rU_input`, …, `BB1Machine.zT_of` — the readers on a round input.
+* `BB1Machine.listToNat_modS`, …, `BB1Machine.listToNat_invS` — the arithmetic in `Z_p`.
+* `BB1Machine.listToNat_pS`, `mulGS_ofFn`, `powGS_ofFn`, `mulT_ofFn`, `memT_ofFn`,
+  `memT_headD` — the group operations on encodings.
+* `BB1Machine.uS_of_blkS` — the drawn exponent's numeral.
+
+## References
+
+* [BB04] D. Boneh, X. Boyen, *Efficient Selective-ID Secure Identity Based Encryption Without
+  Random Oracles*, full version, Cryptology ePrint Archive, Report 2004/172, December 2004
+  (extended abstract: EUROCRYPT 2004, LNCS 3027, pp. 223–238). §4.2 (pp. 6–8): the algorithm
+  `B` in the proof of Theorem 4.1.
+* [PS10] R. Pass, a. shelat, *A Course in Cryptography*, lecture notes, 3rd ed., January 2010.
+  (Algorithm 43.2, the extended Euclidean algorithm; Theorem 52.3, sampling `Z_q`.)
+-/
+
+namespace TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.IdentityBased
+
+open Complexity Turing TCSlib.Cryptography.Games TCSlib.Cryptography.Pairing
+  TCSlib.Cryptography.Composability TCSlib.Cryptography.NumberTheory
+  TCSlib.Cryptography.Candidates
+
+namespace BB1Machine
+
+noncomputable section
+
+variable (G : BilinearGen) (ℓ : PolyExpr) (O : G.Ops)
+
+/-! ### Lengths -/
+
+/-- The width `aWidth G = wG + 1` of the numeral of `α_1` in the state. -/
+def aWidth : PolyExpr := G.wG.add (.const 1)
+
+/-- `(aWidth G).eval κ = wG(κ) + 1`. -/
+theorem aWidth_eval (κ : ℕ) : (aWidth G).eval κ = G.wG.eval κ + 1 := by
+  rw [aWidth, PolyExpr.eval_add, PolyExpr.eval_const]
+
+/-- The block length `nn G = n · n` of one exponent's coins, `n = blockLen G`. -/
+def nn : PolyExpr := (blockLen G).mul (blockLen G)
+
+/-- `(nn G).eval κ = n · n`. -/
+theorem nn_eval (κ : ℕ) : (nn G).eval κ = (blockLen G).eval κ * (blockLen G).eval κ := by
+  rw [nn, PolyExpr.eval_mul]
+
+/-! ### Reading the round input `⟨⟨1^κ, ⟨z, ω⟩⟩, ⟨s, ⟨1^i, x⟩⟩⟩` -/
+
+/-- The parameter `1^κ` of the round input: `rU w = pairFstD (pairFstD w)`. -/
+def rU (w : List Bool) : List Bool := pairFstD (pairFstD w)
+/-- The reduction input `z`: `rZ w = pairFstD (pairSndD (pairFstD w))`. -/
+def rZ (w : List Bool) : List Bool := pairFstD (pairSndD (pairFstD w))
+/-- The seed `ω`: `rW w = pairSndD (pairSndD (pairFstD w))`. -/
+def rW (w : List Bool) : List Bool := pairSndD (pairSndD (pairFstD w))
+/-- The state `s`: `rS w = pairFstD (pairSndD w)`. -/
+def rS (w : List Bool) : List Bool := pairFstD (pairSndD w)
+/-- The oracle index `1^i`: `rI w = pairFstD (pairSndD (pairSndD w))`. -/
+def rI (w : List Bool) : List Bool := pairFstD (pairSndD (pairSndD w))
+/-- The query `x`: `rX w = pairSndD (pairSndD (pairSndD w))`. -/
+def rX (w : List Bool) : List Bool := pairSndD (pairSndD (pairSndD w))
+
+/-- The description `d` of `z = ⟨d, ⟨g, ⟨X, ⟨Y, ⟨Z, T⟩⟩⟩⟩⟩`: `zD w = pairFstD (rZ w)`. -/
+def zD (w : List Bool) : List Bool := pairFstD (rZ w)
+/-- The word of `g`: `zG w = pairFstD (pairSndD (rZ w))`. -/
+def zG (w : List Bool) : List Bool := pairFstD (pairSndD (rZ w))
+/-- The word of `X`: `zX w = pairFstD (pairSndD² (rZ w))`. -/
+def zX (w : List Bool) : List Bool := pairFstD (pairSndD (pairSndD (rZ w)))
+/-- The word of `Y`: `zY w = pairFstD (pairSndD³ (rZ w))`. -/
+def zY (w : List Bool) : List Bool := pairFstD (pairSndD (pairSndD (pairSndD (rZ w))))
+/-- The word of `Z`: `zZ w = pairFstD (pairSndD⁴ (rZ w))`. -/
+def zZ (w : List Bool) : List Bool :=
+  pairFstD (pairSndD (pairSndD (pairSndD (pairSndD (rZ w)))))
+/-- The word of `T`: `zT w = pairSndD⁵ (rZ w)`. -/
+def zT (w : List Bool) : List Bool :=
+  pairSndD (pairSndD (pairSndD (pairSndD (pairSndD (rZ w)))))
+
+/-- The counter `1^j` of the state `⟨1^j, ⟨o_1, o_2⟩⟩`: `sJ w = pairFstD (rS w)`. -/
+def sJ (w : List Bool) : List Bool := pairFstD (rS w)
+/-- The commitment `o_1`: `sO1 w = pairFstD (pairSndD (rS w))`. -/
+def sO1 (w : List Bool) : List Bool := pairFstD (pairSndD (rS w))
+/-- The challenge record `o_2` followed by the padding: `sR w = pairSndD (pairSndD (rS w))`. -/
+def sR (w : List Bool) : List Bool := pairSndD (pairSndD (rS w))
+/-- Whether an identity is committed: `sCom w = [o_1 ≠ []]`. -/
+def sCom (w : List Bool) : Bool := !decide (sO1 w = [])
+/-- Whether a challenge is recorded, the first bit of `o_2`: `sChal w = (sR w).headD false`. -/
+def sChal (w : List Bool) : Bool := (sR w).headD false
+/-- The recorded challenge `C` of `o_2 = 1 ‖ C`: the `ctLen(κ)` bits after the first. -/
+def sC (w : List Bool) : List Bool :=
+  ((sR w).drop 1).take ((bb1Scheme G ℓ).ctLen.eval (rU w).length)
+/-- The challenge record without its padding: `1 :: sC w` if a challenge is recorded, else `[]`. -/
+def sO2 (w : List Bool) : List Bool := if sChal w then true :: sC G ℓ w else []
+/-- The committed identity: `kT w = pairFstD (sO1 w)`. -/
+def kT (w : List Bool) : List Bool := pairFstD (sO1 w)
+/-- The numeral of the committed `α_1`: `kA w = pairSndD (sO1 w)`. -/
+def kA (w : List Bool) : List Bool := pairSndD (sO1 w)
+
+/-! ### Arithmetic modulo `p` and in the groups -/
+
+/-- The numeral of the order `p`: `pS w = orderStr (zD w)`. -/
+def pS (w : List Bool) : List Bool := O.orderStr (zD w)
+/-- `a mod p`: `modS w a = pairSndD (divModStr ⟨a, pS w⟩)`. -/
+def modS (w a : List Bool) : List Bool := pairSndD (divModStr (pairEncode a (pS G O w)))
+/-- The residue of `−a`: `negS w a = modS w (subStr ⟨pS w, modS w a⟩)`. -/
+def negS (w a : List Bool) : List Bool :=
+  modS G O w (subStr (pairEncode (pS G O w) (modS G O w a)))
+/-- `(a + c) mod p`: `addS w a c = modS w (addStr ⟨a, c⟩)`. -/
+def addS (w a c : List Bool) : List Bool := modS G O w (addStr (pairEncode a c))
+/-- `(a · c) mod p`: `mulS w a c = modS w (mulStr ⟨a, c⟩)`. -/
+def mulS (w a c : List Bool) : List Bool := modS G O w (mulStr (pairEncode a c))
+/-- The inverse of `a` modulo `p` (`0` for `a ≡ 0`): `invS w a = pairSndD (xgcdStr ⟨a, pS w⟩)`. -/
+def invS (w a : List Bool) : List Bool := pairSndD (xgcdStr (pairEncode a (pS G O w)))
+/-- The product `x · y` in `G`: `mulGS w x y = mulG ⟨zD w, ⟨x, y⟩⟩`. -/
+def mulGS (w x y : List Bool) : List Bool := O.mulG (pairEncode (zD w) (pairEncode x y))
+/-- The power `x^e` in `G`: `powGS w x e = powG ⟨zD w, ⟨x, e⟩⟩`. -/
+def powGS (w x e : List Bool) : List Bool := O.powG (pairEncode (zD w) (pairEncode x e))
+
+/-! ### The exponent of the query -/
+
+/-- The block of `n · n` seed bits of the `j`-th query:
+`blkS w = ((rW w).drop (j · n²)).take n²` with `j = |sJ w|`. -/
+def blkS (w : List Bool) : List Bool :=
+  ((rW w).drop ((sJ w).length * (nn G).eval (rU w).length)).take ((nn G).eval (rU w).length)
+
+/-- The exponent drawn from the block, as a `(wG(κ) + 1)`-bit numeral:
+`uS w = ⟦(sampleBelowL p (Nat.size p) n n (blkS w)).getD 0⟧_{wG+1}`, `p = ⟦pS w⟧`. -/
+def uS (w : List Bool) : List Bool :=
+  natToList ((aWidth G).eval (rU w).length)
+    ((sampleBelowL (listToNat (pS G O w)) (Nat.size (listToNat (pS G O w)))
+      ((blockLen G).eval (rU w).length) ((blockLen G).eval (rU w).length) (blkS G w)).getD 0)
+
+/-! ### The readers' equations -/
+
+/-- `rU w = pairFstD (pairFstD w)`. -/
+theorem rU_eq (w : List Bool) : rU w = pairFstD (pairFstD w) := rfl
+/-- `rZ w = pairFstD (pairSndD (pairFstD w))`. -/
+theorem rZ_eq (w : List Bool) : rZ w = pairFstD (pairSndD (pairFstD w)) := rfl
+/-- `rW w = pairSndD (pairSndD (pairFstD w))`. -/
+theorem rW_eq (w : List Bool) : rW w = pairSndD (pairSndD (pairFstD w)) := rfl
+/-- `rS w = pairFstD (pairSndD w)`. -/
+theorem rS_eq (w : List Bool) : rS w = pairFstD (pairSndD w) := rfl
+/-- `rI w = pairFstD (pairSndD (pairSndD w))`. -/
+theorem rI_eq (w : List Bool) : rI w = pairFstD (pairSndD (pairSndD w)) := rfl
+/-- `rX w = pairSndD (pairSndD (pairSndD w))`. -/
+theorem rX_eq (w : List Bool) : rX w = pairSndD (pairSndD (pairSndD w)) := rfl
+/-- `zD w = pairFstD (rZ w)`. -/
+theorem zD_eq (w : List Bool) : zD w = pairFstD (rZ w) := rfl
+/-- `zG w = pairFstD (pairSndD (rZ w))`. -/
+theorem zG_eq (w : List Bool) : zG w = pairFstD (pairSndD (rZ w)) := rfl
+/-- `zX w = pairFstD (pairSndD (pairSndD (rZ w)))`. -/
+theorem zX_eq (w : List Bool) : zX w = pairFstD (pairSndD (pairSndD (rZ w))) := rfl
+/-- `zY w = pairFstD (pairSndD (pairSndD (pairSndD (rZ w))))`. -/
+theorem zY_eq (w : List Bool) : zY w = pairFstD (pairSndD (pairSndD (pairSndD (rZ w)))) := rfl
+/-- `zZ w = pairFstD (pairSndD (pairSndD (pairSndD (pairSndD (rZ w)))))`. -/
+theorem zZ_eq (w : List Bool) :
+    zZ w = pairFstD (pairSndD (pairSndD (pairSndD (pairSndD (rZ w))))) := rfl
+/-- `zT w = pairSndD (pairSndD (pairSndD (pairSndD (pairSndD (rZ w)))))`. -/
+theorem zT_eq (w : List Bool) :
+    zT w = pairSndD (pairSndD (pairSndD (pairSndD (pairSndD (rZ w))))) := rfl
+/-- `sJ w = pairFstD (rS w)`. -/
+theorem sJ_eq (w : List Bool) : sJ w = pairFstD (rS w) := rfl
+/-- `sO1 w = pairFstD (pairSndD (rS w))`. -/
+theorem sO1_eq (w : List Bool) : sO1 w = pairFstD (pairSndD (rS w)) := rfl
+/-- `sR w = pairSndD (pairSndD (rS w))`. -/
+theorem sR_eq (w : List Bool) : sR w = pairSndD (pairSndD (rS w)) := rfl
+/-- `sCom w = !decide (sO1 w = [])`. -/
+theorem sCom_eq (w : List Bool) : sCom w = !decide (sO1 w = []) := rfl
+/-- `sChal w = (sR w).headD false`. -/
+theorem sChal_eq (w : List Bool) : sChal w = (sR w).headD false := rfl
+/-- `sC G ℓ w = ((sR w).drop 1).take (ctLen.eval |rU w|)`. -/
+theorem sC_eq (w : List Bool) :
+    sC G ℓ w = ((sR w).drop 1).take ((bb1Scheme G ℓ).ctLen.eval (rU w).length) := rfl
+/-- `sO2 G ℓ w = if sChal w then true :: sC G ℓ w else []`. -/
+theorem sO2_eq (w : List Bool) : sO2 G ℓ w = if sChal w then true :: sC G ℓ w else [] := rfl
+/-- `kT w = pairFstD (sO1 w)`. -/
+theorem kT_eq (w : List Bool) : kT w = pairFstD (sO1 w) := rfl
+/-- `kA w = pairSndD (sO1 w)`. -/
+theorem kA_eq (w : List Bool) : kA w = pairSndD (sO1 w) := rfl
+/-- `pS G O w = orderStr (zD w)`. -/
+theorem pS_eq (w : List Bool) : pS G O w = O.orderStr (zD w) := rfl
+/-- `modS G O w a = pairSndD (divModStr ⟨a, pS G O w⟩)`. -/
+theorem modS_eq (w a : List Bool) :
+    modS G O w a = pairSndD (divModStr (pairEncode a (pS G O w))) := rfl
+/-- `negS G O w a = modS G O w (subStr ⟨pS G O w, modS G O w a⟩)`. -/
+theorem negS_eq (w a : List Bool) :
+    negS G O w a = modS G O w (subStr (pairEncode (pS G O w) (modS G O w a))) := rfl
+/-- `addS G O w a c = modS G O w (addStr ⟨a, c⟩)`. -/
+theorem addS_eq (w a c : List Bool) : addS G O w a c = modS G O w (addStr (pairEncode a c)) :=
+  rfl
+/-- `mulS G O w a c = modS G O w (mulStr ⟨a, c⟩)`. -/
+theorem mulS_eq (w a c : List Bool) : mulS G O w a c = modS G O w (mulStr (pairEncode a c)) :=
+  rfl
+/-- `invS G O w a = pairSndD (xgcdStr ⟨a, pS G O w⟩)`. -/
+theorem invS_eq (w a : List Bool) :
+    invS G O w a = pairSndD (xgcdStr (pairEncode a (pS G O w))) := rfl
+/-- `mulGS G O w x y = mulG ⟨zD w, ⟨x, y⟩⟩`. -/
+theorem mulGS_eq (w x y : List Bool) :
+    mulGS G O w x y = O.mulG (pairEncode (zD w) (pairEncode x y)) := rfl
+/-- `powGS G O w x e = powG ⟨zD w, ⟨x, e⟩⟩`. -/
+theorem powGS_eq (w x e : List Bool) :
+    powGS G O w x e = O.powG (pairEncode (zD w) (pairEncode x e)) := rfl
+/-- `blkS G w = ((rW w).drop (|sJ w| · n²)).take n²`. -/
+theorem blkS_eq (w : List Bool) :
+    blkS G w = ((rW w).drop ((sJ w).length * (nn G).eval (rU w).length)).take
+      ((nn G).eval (rU w).length) := rfl
+/-- `uS G O w = ⟦(sampleBelowL p (Nat.size p) n n (blkS G w)).getD 0⟧_{wG+1}`. -/
+theorem uS_eq (w : List Bool) :
+    uS G O w = natToList ((aWidth G).eval (rU w).length)
+      ((sampleBelowL (listToNat (pS G O w)) (Nat.size (listToNat (pS G O w)))
+        ((blockLen G).eval (rU w).length) ((blockLen G).eval (rU w).length) (blkS G w)).getD 0) :=
+  rfl
+
+/-! ### Polynomial time -/
+
+section Poly
+
+/-- `rU` is polynomial-time (two first projections). -/
+theorem poly_rU : PolyTimeComputable rU :=
+  polyTimeComputable_pairFstD.comp' polyTimeComputable_pairFstD
+/-- `rZ` is polynomial-time. -/
+theorem poly_rZ : PolyTimeComputable rZ :=
+  polyTimeComputable_pairFstD.comp' (polyTimeComputable_pairSndD.comp' polyTimeComputable_pairFstD)
+/-- `rW` is polynomial-time. -/
+theorem poly_rW : PolyTimeComputable rW :=
+  polyTimeComputable_pairSndD.comp' (polyTimeComputable_pairSndD.comp' polyTimeComputable_pairFstD)
+/-- `rS` is polynomial-time. -/
+theorem poly_rS : PolyTimeComputable rS :=
+  polyTimeComputable_pairFstD.comp' polyTimeComputable_pairSndD
+/-- `rI` is polynomial-time. -/
+theorem poly_rI : PolyTimeComputable rI :=
+  polyTimeComputable_pairFstD.comp' (polyTimeComputable_pairSndD.comp' polyTimeComputable_pairSndD)
+/-- `rX` is polynomial-time. -/
+theorem poly_rX : PolyTimeComputable rX :=
+  polyTimeComputable_pairSndD.comp' (polyTimeComputable_pairSndD.comp' polyTimeComputable_pairSndD)
+/-- `zD` is polynomial-time. -/
+theorem poly_zD : PolyTimeComputable zD := polyTimeComputable_pairFstD.comp' poly_rZ
+/-- `zG` is polynomial-time. -/
+theorem poly_zG : PolyTimeComputable zG :=
+  polyTimeComputable_pairFstD.comp' (polyTimeComputable_pairSndD.comp' poly_rZ)
+/-- `zX` is polynomial-time. -/
+theorem poly_zX : PolyTimeComputable zX :=
+  polyTimeComputable_pairFstD.comp' (polyTimeComputable_pairSndD.comp'
+    (polyTimeComputable_pairSndD.comp' poly_rZ))
+/-- `zY` is polynomial-time. -/
+theorem poly_zY : PolyTimeComputable zY :=
+  polyTimeComputable_pairFstD.comp' (polyTimeComputable_pairSndD.comp'
+    (polyTimeComputable_pairSndD.comp' (polyTimeComputable_pairSndD.comp' poly_rZ)))
+/-- `zZ` is polynomial-time. -/
+theorem poly_zZ : PolyTimeComputable zZ :=
+  polyTimeComputable_pairFstD.comp' (polyTimeComputable_pairSndD.comp'
+    (polyTimeComputable_pairSndD.comp' (polyTimeComputable_pairSndD.comp'
+      (polyTimeComputable_pairSndD.comp' poly_rZ))))
+/-- `zT` is polynomial-time. -/
+theorem poly_zT : PolyTimeComputable zT :=
+  polyTimeComputable_pairSndD.comp' (polyTimeComputable_pairSndD.comp'
+    (polyTimeComputable_pairSndD.comp' (polyTimeComputable_pairSndD.comp'
+      (polyTimeComputable_pairSndD.comp' poly_rZ))))
+/-- `sJ` is polynomial-time. -/
+theorem poly_sJ : PolyTimeComputable sJ := polyTimeComputable_pairFstD.comp' poly_rS
+/-- `sO1` is polynomial-time. -/
+theorem poly_sO1 : PolyTimeComputable sO1 :=
+  polyTimeComputable_pairFstD.comp' (polyTimeComputable_pairSndD.comp' poly_rS)
+/-- `sR` is polynomial-time. -/
+theorem poly_sR : PolyTimeComputable sR :=
+  polyTimeComputable_pairSndD.comp' (polyTimeComputable_pairSndD.comp' poly_rS)
+/-- `w ↦ [sCom w]` is polynomial-time (`isNil`, then `not`). -/
+theorem poly_sCom : PolyTimeComputable fun w => [sCom w] :=
+  polyTimeComputable_not (polyTimeComputable_isNil.comp' poly_sO1)
+/-- `w ↦ [sChal w]` is polynomial-time (`headD`). -/
+theorem poly_sChal : PolyTimeComputable fun w => [sChal w] :=
+  polyTimeComputable_headD.comp' poly_sR
+/-- `sC G ℓ` is polynomial-time (`pairTakePoly ctLen` of `⟨rU w, (sR w).tail⟩`). -/
+theorem poly_sC : PolyTimeComputable (sC G ℓ) :=
+  ((polyTimeComputable_pairTakePoly (bb1Scheme G ℓ).ctLen).comp'
+    (poly_rU.pairEncode (polyTimeComputable_tail.comp' poly_sR))).congr fun w => by
+      simp only [pairFstD_pairEncode, pairSndD_pairEncode]; rfl
+/-- `sO2 G ℓ` is polynomial-time (a branch on `sChal`). -/
+theorem poly_sO2 : PolyTimeComputable (sO2 G ℓ) :=
+  (polyTimeComputable_ite poly_sChal ((polyTimeComputable_const [true]).append (poly_sC G ℓ))
+    (polyTimeComputable_const [])).congr fun w => by
+      simp only [sO2, List.singleton_append]
+/-- `kT` is polynomial-time. -/
+theorem poly_kT : PolyTimeComputable kT := polyTimeComputable_pairFstD.comp' poly_sO1
+/-- `kA` is polynomial-time. -/
+theorem poly_kA : PolyTimeComputable kA := polyTimeComputable_pairSndD.comp' poly_sO1
+
+/-- `pS G O` is polynomial-time (`orderStr_poly`). -/
+theorem poly_pS : PolyTimeComputable (pS G O) := O.orderStr_poly.comp' poly_zD
+
+/-- `w ↦ modS G O w (a w)` is polynomial-time for polynomial-time `a` (`H.divMod`). -/
+theorem poly_modS (H : ArithmeticFP) {a : List Bool → List Bool} (ha : PolyTimeComputable a) :
+    PolyTimeComputable fun w => modS G O w (a w) :=
+  polyTimeComputable_pairSndD.comp' (H.divMod.comp' (ha.pairEncode (poly_pS G O)))
+/-- `w ↦ negS G O w (a w)` is polynomial-time for polynomial-time `a` (`H.sub`). -/
+theorem poly_negS (H : ArithmeticFP) {a : List Bool → List Bool} (ha : PolyTimeComputable a) :
+    PolyTimeComputable fun w => negS G O w (a w) :=
+  poly_modS G O H (H.sub.comp' ((poly_pS G O).pairEncode (poly_modS G O H ha)))
+/-- `w ↦ addS G O w (a w) (c w)` is polynomial-time for polynomial-time `a`, `c`. -/
+theorem poly_addS (H : ArithmeticFP) {a c : List Bool → List Bool} (ha : PolyTimeComputable a)
+    (hc : PolyTimeComputable c) : PolyTimeComputable fun w => addS G O w (a w) (c w) :=
+  poly_modS G O H (H.add.comp' (ha.pairEncode hc))
+/-- `w ↦ mulS G O w (a w) (c w)` is polynomial-time for polynomial-time `a`, `c`. -/
+theorem poly_mulS (H : ArithmeticFP) {a c : List Bool → List Bool} (ha : PolyTimeComputable a)
+    (hc : PolyTimeComputable c) : PolyTimeComputable fun w => mulS G O w (a w) (c w) :=
+  poly_modS G O H (H.mul.comp' (ha.pairEncode hc))
+/-- `w ↦ invS G O w (a w)` is polynomial-time for polynomial-time `a` (`H.xgcd`). -/
+theorem poly_invS (H : ArithmeticFP) {a : List Bool → List Bool} (ha : PolyTimeComputable a) :
+    PolyTimeComputable fun w => invS G O w (a w) :=
+  polyTimeComputable_pairSndD.comp' (H.xgcd.comp' (ha.pairEncode (poly_pS G O)))
+/-- `w ↦ mulGS G O w (x w) (y w)` is polynomial-time for polynomial-time `x`, `y`. -/
+theorem poly_mulGS {x y : List Bool → List Bool} (hx : PolyTimeComputable x)
+    (hy : PolyTimeComputable y) : PolyTimeComputable fun w => mulGS G O w (x w) (y w) :=
+  O.mulG_poly.comp' (poly_zD.pairEncode (hx.pairEncode hy))
+/-- `w ↦ powGS G O w (x w) (e w)` is polynomial-time for polynomial-time `x`, `e`. -/
+theorem poly_powGS {x e : List Bool → List Bool} (hx : PolyTimeComputable x)
+    (he : PolyTimeComputable e) : PolyTimeComputable fun w => powGS G O w (x w) (e w) :=
+  O.powG_poly.comp' (poly_zD.pairEncode (hx.pairEncode he))
+
+/-- `blkS G` is polynomial-time: the offset `1^{|sJ w| · n²}`
+(`OneWay.polyTimeComputable_unaryMulPair`), a drop by its length and a take of `n²` bits. -/
+theorem poly_blkS : PolyTimeComputable (blkS G) := by
+  have hOff : PolyTimeComputable fun w =>
+      List.replicate ((sJ w).length * (nn G).eval (rU w).length) true :=
+    (OneWay.polyTimeComputable_unaryMulPair.comp'
+      (poly_sJ.pairEncode ((polyTimeComputable_unaryPoly (nn G)).comp' poly_rU))).congr fun w => by
+        simp only [pairFstD_pairEncode, pairSndD_pairEncode, List.length_replicate]
+  have hDrop : PolyTimeComputable fun w =>
+      (rW w).drop ((sJ w).length * (nn G).eval (rU w).length) :=
+    (polyTimeComputable_dropPrefixByLength.comp' (hOff.pairEncode poly_rW)).congr fun w => by
+      simp only [PrefixByLength.drop_def, pairFstD_pairEncode, pairSndD_pairEncode,
+        List.length_replicate]
+  exact ((polyTimeComputable_pairTakePoly (nn G)).comp' (poly_rU.pairEncode hDrop)).congr
+    fun w => by simp only [pairFstD_pairEncode, pairSndD_pairEncode]; rfl
+
+/-- `uS G O` is polynomial-time.
+
+**Proof sketch.** Apply the block-rejection host `Candidates.polyTimeComputable_rejectBlocksL`
+with the test `v < p` (`H.le`), the width word `sizeStr p` (`H.size`) and `n` blocks of `n`
+bits read from `blkS w`: its output `g w` is empty when the sampler fails, and otherwise its
+tail, of at most `|sizeStr p|` bits, reads as the accepted value
+(`sampleBelowL_eq_rejectBlocksL`). Take the tail, then normalize the width by
+`(⟦0⟧_W ‖ v).drop |v| = ⟦⟦v⟧⟧_W` (`natToList_zero_append_drop`, with `⟦0⟧_W = subStr ⟨1^W, 1^W⟩`
+and `W = wG + 1`), as in `Candidates.polyTimeComputable_expSampleRaw`; on a failure the tail is
+empty and reads as `0`, the fallback value. -/
+theorem poly_uS (H : ArithmeticFP) : PolyTimeComputable (uS G O) := by
+  have hN : PolyTimeComputable fun w => List.replicate ((blockLen G).eval (rU w).length) true :=
+    (polyTimeComputable_unaryPoly (blockLen G)).comp' poly_rU
+  obtain ⟨g, hg, hs⟩ := polyTimeComputable_rejectBlocksL (fun a v => v < a)
+    (acc := fun x => !decide (listToNat (pairFstD x) ≤ listToNat (pairSndD x)))
+    (polyTimeComputable_not (H.le_poly polyTimeComputable_pairFstD polyTimeComputable_pairSndD))
+    (fun w c => by
+      dsimp only
+      rw [pairFstD_pairEncode, pairSndD_pairEncode, ← decide_not, decide_eq_decide, Nat.not_le])
+    (poly_pS G O) (H.size.comp' (poly_pS G O)) hN hN (poly_blkS G)
+  have hb : PolyTimeComputable fun w => (g w).tail :=
+    (PolyTimeComputable.comp' polyTimeComputable_tail hg).congr fun w => List.drop_one
+  have hW : PolyTimeComputable fun w => List.replicate ((aWidth G).eval (rU w).length) true :=
+    (polyTimeComputable_unaryPoly (aWidth G)).comp' poly_rU
+  have hz := H.sub.comp' (hW.pairEncode hW)
+  have hq := (polyTimeComputable_pairDropPoly .var).comp' (hb.pairEncode (hz.append hb))
+  refine hq.congr fun w => ?_
+  simp only [pairFstD_pairEncode, pairSndD_pairEncode, PolyExpr.eval_var, subStr_self,
+    List.length_replicate]
+  rw [natToList_zero_append_drop, uS, sampleBelowL_eq_rejectBlocksL]
+  have h2 := (hs w).2
+  rw [length_sizeStr, List.length_replicate] at h2
+  rw [h2]
+  split_ifs with he
+  · rw [he, List.tail_nil, listToNat_nil]
+    rfl
+  · rfl
+
+end Poly
+
+/-! ### Reading the round input -/
+
+section Fields
+
+variable {κ : ℕ} {z W S X : List Bool} {i : Fin 3}
+
+/-- `rU (input κ z ω s i x) = 1^κ`. -/
+theorem rU_input : rU (PolyHandler.input κ z W S i X) = List.replicate κ true := by
+  rw [PolyHandler.input_eq, rU, pairFstD_pairEncode, pairFstD_pairEncode]
+/-- `rZ (input κ z ω s i x) = z`. -/
+theorem rZ_input : rZ (PolyHandler.input κ z W S i X) = z := by
+  rw [PolyHandler.input_eq, rZ, pairFstD_pairEncode, pairSndD_pairEncode, pairFstD_pairEncode]
+/-- `rW (input κ z ω s i x) = ω`. -/
+theorem rW_input : rW (PolyHandler.input κ z W S i X) = W := by
+  rw [PolyHandler.input_eq, rW, pairFstD_pairEncode, pairSndD_pairEncode, pairSndD_pairEncode]
+/-- `rS (input κ z ω s i x) = s`. -/
+theorem rS_input : rS (PolyHandler.input κ z W S i X) = S := by
+  rw [PolyHandler.input_eq, rS, pairSndD_pairEncode, pairFstD_pairEncode]
+/-- `rI (input κ z ω s i x) = 1^i`. -/
+theorem rI_input : rI (PolyHandler.input κ z W S i X) = List.replicate i true := by
+  rw [PolyHandler.input_eq, rI, pairSndD_pairEncode, pairSndD_pairEncode, pairFstD_pairEncode]
+/-- `rX (input κ z ω s i x) = x`. -/
+theorem rX_input : rX (PolyHandler.input κ z W S i X) = X := by
+  rw [PolyHandler.input_eq, rX, pairSndD_pairEncode, pairSndD_pairEncode, pairSndD_pairEncode]
+
+end Fields
+
+section Tuple
+
+variable {w : List Bool} {wG wT : ℕ} {B : BilinearGroup wG wT} {d : List Bool}
+  {g X Y Z : B.G} {T : B.GT}
+
+/-- `zD w = d` when `rZ w = tupleStr B d g X Y Z T`. -/
+theorem zD_of (h : rZ w = tupleStr B d g X Y Z T) : zD w = d := by
+  rw [zD, h, tupleStr_eq, pairFstD_pairEncode]
+/-- `zG w = ⟦g⟧` when `rZ w = tupleStr B d g X Y Z T`. -/
+theorem zG_of (h : rZ w = tupleStr B d g X Y Z T) : zG w = List.ofFn (B.encG g) := by
+  rw [zG, h, tupleStr_eq, pairSndD_pairEncode, pairFstD_pairEncode]
+/-- `zX w = ⟦X⟧` when `rZ w = tupleStr B d g X Y Z T`. -/
+theorem zX_of (h : rZ w = tupleStr B d g X Y Z T) : zX w = List.ofFn (B.encG X) := by
+  rw [zX, h, tupleStr_eq, pairSndD_pairEncode, pairSndD_pairEncode, pairFstD_pairEncode]
+/-- `zY w = ⟦Y⟧` when `rZ w = tupleStr B d g X Y Z T`. -/
+theorem zY_of (h : rZ w = tupleStr B d g X Y Z T) : zY w = List.ofFn (B.encG Y) := by
+  rw [zY, h, tupleStr_eq, pairSndD_pairEncode, pairSndD_pairEncode, pairSndD_pairEncode,
+    pairFstD_pairEncode]
+/-- `zZ w = ⟦Z⟧` when `rZ w = tupleStr B d g X Y Z T`. -/
+theorem zZ_of (h : rZ w = tupleStr B d g X Y Z T) : zZ w = List.ofFn (B.encG Z) := by
+  rw [zZ, h, tupleStr_eq, pairSndD_pairEncode, pairSndD_pairEncode, pairSndD_pairEncode,
+    pairSndD_pairEncode, pairFstD_pairEncode]
+/-- `zT w = ⟦T⟧` when `rZ w = tupleStr B d g X Y Z T`. -/
+theorem zT_of (h : rZ w = tupleStr B d g X Y Z T) : zT w = List.ofFn (B.encT T) := by
+  rw [zT, h, tupleStr_eq, pairSndD_pairEncode, pairSndD_pairEncode, pairSndD_pairEncode,
+    pairSndD_pairEncode, pairSndD_pairEncode]
+
+end Tuple
+
+/-! ### Arithmetic modulo `p` on numerals -/
+
+section Arith
+
+variable {w : List Bool} {p : ℕ} [NeZero p]
+
+omit [NeZero p] in
+/-- The order read from `pS` fits its numeral: `p < 2^{|pS w|}`. -/
+theorem pS_lt (hp : listToNat (pS G O w) = p) : p < 2 ^ (pS G O w).length :=
+  hp ▸ listToNat_lt_two_pow _
+
+/-- `⟦a mod p⟧ = (a : Z_p).val`. -/
+theorem listToNat_modS (hp : listToNat (pS G O w) = p) (a : List Bool) :
+    listToNat (modS G O w a) = ((listToNat a : ZMod p)).val := by
+  rw [modS, divModStr_pairEncode, pairSndD_pairEncode, hp, ZMod.val_natCast]
+  exact listToNat_natToList ((Nat.mod_lt _ (NeZero.pos p)).trans (pS_lt G O hp))
+
+/-- `⟦−a mod p⟧ = (−(a : Z_p)).val`. -/
+theorem listToNat_negS (hp : listToNat (pS G O w) = p) (a : List Bool) :
+    listToNat (negS G O w a) = (-(listToNat a : ZMod p)).val := by
+  rw [negS, listToNat_modS G O hp, listToNat_subStr, hp, listToNat_modS G O hp, ZMod.neg_val',
+    ZMod.val_natCast]
+
+/-- `⟦(a + c) mod p⟧ = ((a : Z_p) + c).val`. -/
+theorem listToNat_addS (hp : listToNat (pS G O w) = p) (a c : List Bool) :
+    listToNat (addS G O w a c) = ((listToNat a : ZMod p) + (listToNat c : ZMod p)).val := by
+  rw [addS, listToNat_modS G O hp, listToNat_addStr, Nat.cast_add]
+
+/-- `⟦(a · c) mod p⟧ = ((a : Z_p) · c).val`. -/
+theorem listToNat_mulS (hp : listToNat (pS G O w) = p) (a c : List Bool) :
+    listToNat (mulS G O w a c) = ((listToNat a : ZMod p) * (listToNat c : ZMod p)).val := by
+  rw [mulS, listToNat_modS G O hp, listToNat_mulStr, Nat.cast_mul]
+
+/-- `⟦a⁻¹ mod p⟧ = ((a : Z_p)⁻¹).val` (the extended Euclidean algorithm; `0⁻¹ = 0`). -/
+theorem listToNat_invS (hp : listToNat (pS G O w) = p) (a : List Bool) :
+    listToNat (invS G O w a) = ((listToNat a : ZMod p)⁻¹).val := by
+  rw [invS, xgcdStr_pairEncode, pairSndD_pairEncode, hp]
+  exact listToNat_natToList ((ZMod.val_lt _).trans (pS_lt G O hp))
+
+end Arith
+
+/-! ### Group operations on encodings -/
+
+section Group
+
+variable {w : List Bool} {κ : ℕ} {r : G.gen.Coins κ}
+
+/-- `⟦pS⟧ = p` on the generated description. -/
+theorem listToNat_pS (hD : zD w = G.desc κ r) :
+    listToNat (pS G O w) = (G.group κ (G.desc κ r)).order := by
+  have h := O.orderStr_spec κ r
+  rw [BilinearGen.inst_eq] at h
+  rw [pS, hD]
+  exact h
+
+/-- `mulG` on encodings: `⟦x⟧ · ⟦y⟧ = ⟦x · y⟧`. -/
+theorem mulGS_ofFn (hD : zD w = G.desc κ r) (x y : (G.group κ (G.desc κ r)).G) :
+    mulGS G O w (List.ofFn ((G.group κ (G.desc κ r)).encG x))
+      (List.ofFn ((G.group κ (G.desc κ r)).encG y)) =
+      List.ofFn ((G.group κ (G.desc κ r)).encG (x * y)) := by
+  have h := O.mulG_spec κ r
+  rw [BilinearGen.inst_eq] at h
+  rw [mulGS, hD]
+  exact h x y
+
+/-- `powG` on encodings: `⟦x⟧^e = ⟦x^{⟦e⟧}⟧`. -/
+theorem powGS_ofFn (hD : zD w = G.desc κ r) (x : (G.group κ (G.desc κ r)).G)
+    (e : List Bool) :
+    powGS G O w (List.ofFn ((G.group κ (G.desc κ r)).encG x)) e =
+      List.ofFn ((G.group κ (G.desc κ r)).encG (x ^ listToNat e)) := by
+  have h := O.powG_spec κ r
+  rw [BilinearGen.inst_eq] at h
+  rw [powGS, hD]
+  exact h x e
+
+/-- `mulT` on encodings: `⟦u⟧ · ⟦v⟧ = ⟦u · v⟧` in `G_T`. -/
+theorem mulT_ofFn (hD : zD w = G.desc κ r) (u v : (G.group κ (G.desc κ r)).GT) :
+    O.mulT (pairEncode (zD w) (pairEncode (List.ofFn ((G.group κ (G.desc κ r)).encT u))
+      (List.ofFn ((G.group κ (G.desc κ r)).encT v)))) =
+      List.ofFn ((G.group κ (G.desc κ r)).encT (u * v)) := by
+  have h := O.mulT_spec κ r
+  rw [BilinearGen.inst_eq] at h
+  rw [hD]
+  exact h u v
+
+/-- `memT` on encodings: `[w encodes an element of G_T]`. -/
+theorem memT_ofFn (hD : zD w = G.desc κ r) (m : Fin (G.wT.eval κ) → Bool) :
+    O.memT (pairEncode (zD w) (List.ofFn m)) =
+      [decide (∃ u, (G.group κ (G.desc κ r)).encT u = m)] := by
+  have h := O.memT_spec κ r
+  rw [BilinearGen.inst_eq] at h
+  rw [hD]
+  exact h m
+
+/-- The membership test on a `wT`-bit word: `(memT ⟨d, l⟩).headD false = [l encodes some u]`. -/
+theorem memT_headD (hD : zD w = G.desc κ r) (l : List Bool) (hl : l.length = G.wT.eval κ) :
+    (O.memT (pairEncode (zD w) l)).headD false =
+      decide (∃ u, List.ofFn ((G.group κ (G.desc κ r)).encT u) = l) := by
+  have h := memT_ofFn G O hD (padFin _ l)
+  rw [ofFn_padFin_of_length hl] at h
+  rw [h, List.headD_cons, decide_eq_decide]
+  constructor
+  · rintro ⟨u, hu⟩
+    exact ⟨u, by rw [hu, ofFn_padFin_of_length hl]⟩
+  · rintro ⟨u, hu⟩
+    exact ⟨u, by rw [← hu, padFin_ofFn]⟩
+
+end Group
+
+/-! ### The order and the identities -/
+
+section Order
+
+variable {κ : ℕ}
+
+/-- The width of `α_1`'s numeral is `wG + 1`, and the order is below `2^{wG + 1}`. -/
+theorem order_lt_aWidth (κ : ℕ) (d : List Bool) :
+    (G.group κ d).order < 2 ^ (aWidth G).eval κ := by
+  rw [aWidth, PolyExpr.eval_add, PolyExpr.eval_const, pow_succ]
+  have := order_le_two_pow G κ d
+  have h2 : 0 < 2 ^ G.wG.eval κ := Nat.two_pow_pos _
+  omega
+
+/-- The numeral of a residue at width `wG + 1` reads back as its value. -/
+theorem listToNat_natToList_val {d : List Bool} (v : ZMod (G.group κ d).order) :
+    listToNat (natToList ((aWidth G).eval κ) v.val) = v.val :=
+  listToNat_natToList ((ZMod.val_lt v).trans (order_lt_aWidth G κ d))
+
+/-- An identity read in `Z_p` is its numeral's residue:
+`idToZ (padFin _ ⟦x⟧) = (⟦x⟧ : Z_p)`. -/
+theorem idToZ_padFin {d : List Bool} {e : ℕ} (x : Fin e → Bool)
+    (h : e = (bb1Scheme G ℓ).idLen.eval κ) :
+    BB1.idToZ (G.group κ d) (padFin ((bb1Scheme G ℓ).idLen.eval κ) (List.ofFn x)) =
+      ((listToNat (List.ofFn x) : ℕ) : ZMod (G.group κ d).order) := by
+  rw [BB1.idToZ_eq, NumberTheory.bitsToNat_eq_listToNat,
+    ofFn_padFin_of_length (by rw [List.length_ofFn, h])]
+
+end Order
+
+/-! ### The drawn exponent -/
+
+/-- **The drawn exponent's numeral**: if the block of the query is `⟦v⟧`, then
+`uS w = ⟦(draw G κ d v).val⟧_{wG+1}` (`draw_eq`; a drawn value is below `p`). -/
+theorem uS_of_blkS {w : List Bool} {κ : ℕ} {r : G.gen.Coins κ} (hU : (rU w).length = κ)
+    (hD : zD w = G.desc κ r) (v : Fin ((blockLen G).eval κ * (blockLen G).eval κ) → Bool)
+    (hv : blkS G w = List.ofFn v) :
+    uS G O w = natToList ((aWidth G).eval κ) (draw G κ (G.desc κ r) v).val := by
+  have hp := listToNat_pS G O hD
+  rw [uS, hU, hp, hv, draw_eq, ZMod.val_natCast, Nat.mod_eq_of_lt]
+  generalize hs : sampleBelowL _ _ _ _ _ = o
+  rcases o with _ | u
+  · exact (G.group κ (G.desc κ r)).order_prime.pos
+  · exact sampleBelowL_lt hs
+
+end
+
+end BB1Machine
+
+end TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.IdentityBased

index 6c9331020..b0fc112a2 100644
--- a/TCSlib/Cryptography/AdvancedEncryption/IdentityBased/Defs.lean
+++ b/TCSlib/Cryptography/AdvancedEncryption/IdentityBased/Defs.lean
@@ -386,6 +386,49 @@ theorem oracleImpl_two {σ : Type} (κ : ℕ)
     (x : Fin (S.msgLen.eval κ + S.msgLen.eval κ) → Bool) (s : σ) :
     S.oracleImpl κ init key chal 2 x s = chal x s := rfl
 
+/-- **Oracle `0` of `oracleImpl` on the game's query type**: the handler `init` on the query read
+as an identity, its answer read back on the game's answer type. -/
+theorem oracleImpl_zero_onSpec {σ : Type} (κ : ℕ)
+    (init : (Fin (S.idLen.eval κ) → Bool) → σ → ProbComp ((Fin (S.ppLen.eval κ) → Bool) × σ))
+    (key : (Fin (S.idLen.eval κ) → Bool) → σ → ProbComp ((Fin (S.skLen.eval κ + 1) → Bool) × σ))
+    (chal : (Fin (S.msgLen.eval κ + S.msgLen.eval κ) → Bool) → σ →
+      ProbComp ((Fin (S.ctLen.eval κ) → Bool) × σ))
+    (x : (S.sidSpec κ).dom 0) (s : σ) :
+    S.oracleImpl κ init key chal 0 x s =
+      (init (cast (show (S.sidSpec κ).dom 0 = (Fin (S.idLen.eval κ) → Bool) from rfl) x) s).bind
+        fun p => .pure (cast (show (S.sidSpec κ).rng 0 = (Fin (S.ppLen.eval κ) → Bool)
+          from rfl).symm p.1, p.2) :=
+  (OracleComp.bind_pure _).symm
+
+/-- **Oracle `1` of `oracleImpl` on the game's query type**: the handler `key` on the query read
+as an identity, its answer read back on the game's answer type. -/
+theorem oracleImpl_one_onSpec {σ : Type} (κ : ℕ)
+    (init : (Fin (S.idLen.eval κ) → Bool) → σ → ProbComp ((Fin (S.ppLen.eval κ) → Bool) × σ))
+    (key : (Fin (S.idLen.eval κ) → Bool) → σ → ProbComp ((Fin (S.skLen.eval κ + 1) → Bool) × σ))
+    (chal : (Fin (S.msgLen.eval κ + S.msgLen.eval κ) → Bool) → σ →
+      ProbComp ((Fin (S.ctLen.eval κ) → Bool) × σ))
+    (x : (S.sidSpec κ).dom 1) (s : σ) :
+    S.oracleImpl κ init key chal 1 x s =
+      (key (cast (show (S.sidSpec κ).dom 1 = (Fin (S.idLen.eval κ) → Bool) from rfl) x) s).bind
+        fun p => .pure (cast (show (S.sidSpec κ).rng 1 = (Fin (S.skLen.eval κ + 1) → Bool)
+          from rfl).symm p.1, p.2) :=
+  (OracleComp.bind_pure _).symm
+
+/-- **Oracle `2` of `oracleImpl` on the game's query type**: the handler `chal` on the query read
+as two messages, its answer read back on the game's answer type. -/
+theorem oracleImpl_two_onSpec {σ : Type} (κ : ℕ)
+    (init : (Fin (S.idLen.eval κ) → Bool) → σ → ProbComp ((Fin (S.ppLen.eval κ) → Bool) × σ))
+    (key : (Fin (S.idLen.eval κ) → Bool) → σ → ProbComp ((Fin (S.skLen.eval κ + 1) → Bool) × σ))
+    (chal : (Fin (S.msgLen.eval κ + S.msgLen.eval κ) → Bool) → σ →
+      ProbComp ((Fin (S.ctLen.eval κ) → Bool) × σ))
+    (x : (S.sidSpec κ).dom 2) (s : σ) :
+    S.oracleImpl κ init key chal 2 x s =
+      (chal (cast (show (S.sidSpec κ).dom 2 = (Fin (S.msgLen.eval κ + S.msgLen.eval κ) → Bool)
+        from rfl) x) s).bind
+        fun p => .pure (cast (show (S.sidSpec κ).rng 2 = (Fin (S.ctLen.eval κ) → Bool)
+          from rfl).symm p.1, p.2) :=
+  (OracleComp.bind_pure _).symm
+
 /-- The codec of the adversary: the three oracles and a one-bit guess. -/
 def sidCodec (κ : ℕ) : MachineCodec (S.sidSpec κ) (Fin 1 → Bool) :=
   bitCodec (S.inLens κ) (S.outLens κ) 1

 import TCSlib.Cryptography.Asymptotic.Adversary
 import TCSlib.Cryptography.Games.Advantage
 import TCSlib.Cryptography.Foundations.Negligible

       pairEncode d (pairEncode (List.ofFn (B.encG g)) (pairEncode (List.ofFn (B.encG x))

+/-! ### The Decision BDH distinguisher of a BDH solver
+
+The machine behind `BilinearGen.bdhAssumption_of_dbdhAssumption`: on a Decision BDH string it
+re-pairs the first five components into a BDH string, runs the solver on it and compares the
+answer with the last component. These helpers are internal to that proof. -/
+
+/-- The BDH part of a Decision BDH string, by the pair projections:
+`⟨d, ⟨g, ⟨X, ⟨Y, ⟨Z, T⟩⟩⟩⟩⟩ ↦ ⟨d, ⟨g, ⟨X, ⟨Y, Z⟩⟩⟩⟩` (every string is mapped to some string). -/
+private def tupleBdh (w : List Bool) : List Bool :=
+  pairEncode (pairFstD w) (pairEncode (pairFstD (pairSndD w))
+    (pairEncode (pairFstD (pairSndD (pairSndD w)))
+      (pairEncode (pairFstD (pairSndD (pairSndD (pairSndD w))))
+        (pairFstD (pairSndD (pairSndD (pairSndD (pairSndD w))))))))
+
+/-- The last component of a Decision BDH string: `⟨d, ⟨g, ⟨X, ⟨Y, ⟨Z, T⟩⟩⟩⟩⟩ ↦ T`, the fifth
+iterate of the second projection. -/
+private def tupleTgt (w : List Bool) : List Bool :=
+  pairSndD (pairSndD (pairSndD (pairSndD (pairSndD w))))
+
+/-- The BDH part of a Decision BDH string is the BDH string of its first five components:
+`tupleBdh (tupleStr B d g x y z t) = bdhStr B d g x y z`. -/
+private theorem tupleBdh_tupleStr {wG wT : ℕ} (B : BilinearGroup wG wT) (d : List Bool)
+    (g x y z : B.G) (t : B.GT) : tupleBdh (tupleStr B d g x y z t) = bdhStr B d g x y z := by
+  rw [tupleStr_eq, bdhStr_eq, tupleBdh]
+  simp only [pairFstD_pairEncode, pairSndD_pairEncode]
+
+/-- The last component of a Decision BDH string is the encoding of its target element:
+`tupleTgt (tupleStr B d g x y z t) = List.ofFn (B.encT t)`. -/
+private theorem tupleTgt_tupleStr {wG wT : ℕ} (B : BilinearGroup wG wT) (d : List Bool)
+    (g x y z : B.G) (t : B.GT) : tupleTgt (tupleStr B d g x y z t) = List.ofFn (B.encT t) := by
+  rw [tupleStr_eq, tupleTgt]
+  simp only [pairSndD_pairEncode]
+
+/-- The re-pairing `tupleBdh` is polynomial-time (pair projections and `pairEncode`). -/
+private theorem polyTimeComputable_tupleBdh : PolyTimeComputable tupleBdh := by
+  have s₁ := polyTimeComputable_pairSndD
+  have s₂ := s₁.comp' s₁
+  have s₃ := s₁.comp' s₂
+  have s₄ := s₁.comp' s₃
+  have f := polyTimeComputable_pairFstD
+  unfold tupleBdh
+  exact f.pairEncode ((f.comp' s₁).pairEncode ((f.comp' s₂).pairEncode
+    ((f.comp' s₃).pairEncode (f.comp' s₄))))
+
+/-- The projection `tupleTgt` is polynomial-time (five second projections). -/
+private theorem polyTimeComputable_tupleTgt : PolyTimeComputable tupleTgt := by
+  have s := polyTimeComputable_pairSndD
+  unfold tupleTgt
+  exact s.comp' (s.comp' (s.comp' (s.comp' s)))
+
+/-- **The Decision BDH distinguisher of a BDH solver** (the machine of

+`polyTimeComputable_layout`, the layout projections and `polyTimeComputable_pairEq`.
